svg.title: haze
svg.script:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="haze">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, shrink-to-fit=no" />
<title>haze</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2064%2064%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%2264%22%20height%3D%2264%22%20rx%3D%2214%22%20fill%3D%22%23050505%22%2F%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%2232%22%20y%3D%2244%22%20font-family%3D%22system-ui%2C%20sans-serif%22%20font-size%3D%2234%22%20font-weight%3D%22700%22%20fill%3D%22%23f5f5f5%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%3Eh%3C%2Ftext%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%2216%22%20y%3D%2249%22%20width%3D%2232%22%20height%3D%223%22%20rx%3D%221.5%22%20fill%3D%22%23f5f5f5%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E" type="image/svg+xml" />

<!-- STYLES -->
<style>
:root {
  --bg: #050505;
  --bg-elev: #0d0d0d;
  --panel: #101010;
  --border: #232323;
  --text: #f5f5f5;
  --muted: #9a9a9a;
  --accent: #ffffff;
  --accent-contrast: #000000;
  --glow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --grid-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  --side-w: 220px;
}

html[data-theme="haze"] {
  --bg: #050505; --bg-elev: #0d0d0d; --panel: #101010; --border: #232323;
  --text: #f5f5f5; --muted: #9a9a9a;
  --accent: #ffffff; --accent-contrast: #000000;
  --glow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); --grid-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

html[data-theme="galaxy"] {
  --bg: #07020f; --bg-elev: #120a24; --panel: #170d2b; --border: #31224f;
  --text: #f2ecff; --muted: #a795c9;
  --accent: #b79bff; --accent-contrast: #0a0416;
  --glow: rgba(150, 110, 255, 0.22); --grid-line: rgba(160, 120, 255, 0.07);
}

html[data-theme="midnight"] {
  --bg: #04070d; --bg-elev: #0a1220; --panel: #0d1626; --border: #1d2c44;
  --text: #e8f0fb; --muted: #8aa0bd;
  --accent: #6ea8ff; --accent-contrast: #03080f;
  --glow: rgba(110, 168, 255, 0.18); --grid-line: rgba(120, 170, 255, 0.06);
}

html[data-theme="cream"] {
  --bg: #faf8f2; --bg-elev: #ffffff; --panel: #ffffff; --border: #e2ddd0;
  --text: #1d1a13; --muted: #7a7466;
  --accent: #191611; --accent-contrast: #faf8f2;
  --glow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); --grid-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

html[data-theme="rose"] {
  --bg: #0c0507; --bg-elev: #1c0b12; --panel: #230e17; --border: #3f1c2a;
  --text: #fdeef3; --muted: #c797a8;
  --accent: #ff9db8; --accent-contrast: #1a070d;
  --glow: rgba(255, 140, 175, 0.2); --grid-line: rgba(255, 150, 180, 0.07);
}

html[data-theme="matrix"] {
  --bg: #010602; --bg-elev: #03120a; --panel: #041609; --border: #0d331c;
  --text: #d3ffe3; --muted: #6faa85;
  --accent: #4dff88; --accent-contrast: #00110a;
  --glow: rgba(77, 255, 136, 0.16); --grid-line: rgba(77, 255, 136, 0.06);
}

html[data-theme="glass"] {
  --bg: #0a0a10; --bg-elev: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); --panel: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38); --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  --text: #f5f5f7; --muted: rgba(235, 235, 245, 0.65);
  --accent: #ffffff; --accent-contrast: #0a0a0c;
  --glow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); --grid-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

html[data-theme="sakura"] {
  --bg: #150a10; --bg-elev: #24121c; --panel: #2a1520; --border: #4a2436;
  --text: #ffeef5; --muted: #d19bad;
  --accent: #ff9ecb; --accent-contrast: #1a0710;
  --glow: rgba(255, 158, 203, 0.22); --grid-line: rgba(255, 170, 210, 0.07);
}

html[data-theme="sakura"] body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(1100px 500px at 75% -8%, rgba(255, 130, 190, 0.20), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(900px 420px at 12% 108%, rgba(120, 60, 110, 0.28), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(165deg, #1e0d15 0%, #341722 48%, #170a10 100%) fixed;
}

html[data-theme="emerald"] {
  --bg: #04120c; --bg-elev: #0a2318; --panel: #0d2a1c; --border: #1b4a32;
  --text: #e4fff1; --muted: #7fc7a1;
  --accent: #34e08a; --accent-contrast: #03140c;
  --glow: rgba(52, 224, 138, 0.2); --grid-line: rgba(80, 230, 150, 0.07);
}
html[data-theme="emerald"] body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(1000px 480px at 85% -10%, rgba(50, 220, 130, 0.16), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(900px 500px at 8% 105%, rgba(10, 80, 50, 0.35), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, #061a10 0%, #0b3a24 50%, #04120c 100%) fixed;
}

html[data-theme="ruby"] {
  --bg: #140404; --bg-elev: #2a0a0c; --panel: #310d10; --border: #571119;
  --text: #ffe9ea; --muted: #d08f95;
  --accent: #ff4457; --accent-contrast: #1c0507;
  --glow: rgba(255, 68, 87, 0.22); --grid-line: rgba(255, 100, 110, 0.07);
}
html[data-theme="ruby"] body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(1050px 460px at 80% -10%, rgba(255, 60, 80, 0.20), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(900px 460px at 10% 108%, rgba(110, 10, 25, 0.35), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(162deg, #20070a 0%, #41111a 50%, #14040a 100%) fixed;
}

html[data-theme="halloween"] {
  --bg: #0e0900; --bg-elev: #221604; --panel: #281a05; --border: #4c3310;
  --text: #fff3de; --muted: #cba478;
  --accent: #ff9933; --accent-contrast: #140c00;
  --glow: rgba(255, 153, 51, 0.25); --grid-line: rgba(255, 170, 70, 0.08);
}
html[data-theme="halloween"] body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(980px 420px at 50% -12%, rgba(255, 140, 30, 0.22), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(860px 420px at 85% 108%, rgba(70, 30, 90, 0.28), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(700px 380px at 10% 100%, rgba(60, 20, 70, 0.22), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(168deg, #1b1002 0%, #3d2508 48%, #100a01 100%) fixed;
}

html[data-theme="golden"] {
  --bg: #120e00; --bg-elev: #26200a; --panel: #2c250c; --border: #514420;
  --text: #fff7dd; --muted: #d4bd88;
  --accent: #ffcf5c; --accent-contrast: #161100;
  --glow: rgba(255, 207, 92, 0.22); --grid-line: rgba(255, 215, 120, 0.08);
}
html[data-theme="golden"] body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(1000px 460px at 78% -10%, rgba(255, 200, 80, 0.18), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(880px 460px at 12% 108%, rgba(120, 90, 20, 0.32), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(165deg, #1c1504 0%, #3f3210 50%, #120e00 100%) fixed;
}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
}

.muted { color: var(--muted); }

.grid-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 44px 44px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, black 30%, transparent 75%);
}

.wallpaper {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background-size: cover; background-position: center;
  opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
}
.wallpaper.visible { opacity: 0.55; }
.wallpaper.visible + .grid-overlay { opacity: 0.25; }

.glass-blobs { display: none; }
html[data-theme^="glass"] .glass-blobs {
  display: block;
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none;
}
.glass-blobs span {
  position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(70px); opacity: 0.55;
  will-change: transform;
}
.glass-blobs span:nth-child(1) { width: 46vmax; height: 46vmax; left: -14vmax; top: -16vmax; background: #4f46e5; animation: blob-a 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.glass-blobs span:nth-child(2) { width: 36vmax; height: 36vmax; right: -10vmax; top: -8vmax; background: #0ea5e9; animation: blob-b 30s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.glass-blobs span:nth-child(3) { width: 40vmax; height: 40vmax; left: 22vw; bottom: -18vmax; background: #ec4899; animation: blob-a 27s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
.glass-blobs span:nth-child(4) { width: 28vmax; height: 28vmax; right: 6vw; bottom: -10vmax; background: #f59e0b; opacity: 0.4; animation: blob-b 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.glass-blobs span:nth-child(5) { width: 22vmax; height: 22vmax; left: 44vw; top: 30vh; background: #8b5cf6; opacity: 0.45; animation: blob-a 33s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }

@keyframes blob-a {
  from { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  to   { transform: translate3d(5vmax, 4vmax, 0) scale(1.15); }
}
@keyframes blob-b {
  from { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  to   { transform: translate3d(-6vmax, 3vmax, 0) scale(0.92); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .glass-blobs span { animation: none; }
}

@keyframes rise-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes pop-in {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.94); }
  60%  { transform: scale(1.015); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

@keyframes slide-right {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-10px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
}@keyframes underline-grow {
  from { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0); }
  to { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1); }
}

.sidebar { animation: slide-right 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; }
.nav-item { animation: slide-right 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; }
.nav-item:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.06s; }
.nav-item:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.12s; }
.nav-item:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.18s; }
.nav-item:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.24s; }
.nav-item:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.sidebar-foot { animation: fadein 0.6s ease 0.3s both; }

.hero-clock { animation: rise-in 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; }
.hero-clock-time { font-size: clamp(3rem, 9vw, 5.5rem); }
.view-home .logo { animation: rise-in 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.08s both; }
.hero-quote { animation: rise-in 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.16s both; }
.view-home #sj-form { animation: rise-in 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.22s both; }

.shortcuts { animation: rise-in 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.3s both; }
.shortcuts button {
  animation: pop-in 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease;
}
.shortcuts button:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.34s; }
.shortcuts button:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.shortcuts button:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.46s; }
.shortcuts button:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.52s; }
.shortcuts button:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
.shortcuts button:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96); }

.widgets { animation: fadein 0.4s ease 0.36s both; }
.widget {
  animation: rise-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.widget:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.38s; }
.widget:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.44s; }
.widget:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.widget:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.56s; }
.widget:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.62s; }
.widget:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.68s; }
.widget:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 0.74s; }
.widget:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.view-home .logo {
  position: relative;
}
.view-home .logo::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -8px;
  width: 100%; height: 3px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: currentColor;
  transform-origin: center;
  animation: underline-grow 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.3s both;
}

.view { animation: rise-in 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); }
.view-head h2 { animation: rise-in 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; }
.view-head .muted { animation: fadein 0.5s ease 0.08s both; }

.music-head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.music-toolbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.music-cats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; animation: fadein 0.5s ease 0.08s both; }
.music-cat {
  padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 78%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem; font-family: inherit; backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.music-cat:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.music-cat.active {
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-contrast); border-color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.music-add { display: flex; gap: 8px; animation: fadein 0.5s ease 0.16s both; }
.music-add input {
  width: min(320px, 70vw); padding: 10px 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 80%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--text); font-size: 0.9rem; font-family: inherit; outline: none;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.music-add input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
.music-add input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--glow); }

.music-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 26px;
}
.music-card {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch;
  text-align: left; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 78%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px;
  color: var(--text); font-family: inherit;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  animation: rise-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.music-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 22px var(--glow);
}
.music-card:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); }
.music-card-cover {
  position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-elev); overflow: hidden;
}
.music-card-cover img {
  position: relative; z-index: 1; 
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
  filter: saturate(0.92);
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 0.3s ease;
}
.music-card:hover .music-card-cover img { transform: scale(1.05); filter: saturate(1.05); }
.music-card-glyph {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center;
  font-size: 2.6rem; color: var(--muted); opacity: 0.55;
}
.music-card-title {
  padding: 11px 13px 2px; font-size: 0.93rem; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.3;
}
.music-card-sub {
  padding: 0 13px 6px; font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--muted);
}
.music-card-note {
  padding: 0 13px 12px; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--accent); opacity: 0.85;
}
.music-card { position: relative; }
.music-star {
  position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; z-index: 2;
  width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 65%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px); padding: 0;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.music-star:hover { transform: scale(1.15); color: var(--text); border-color: var(--accent); }
.music-star.active { color: #ffd166; border-color: #ffd166; }
.music-card[hidden] { display: none; }

.music-player {
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-elev);
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--glow);
  animation: fadein 0.5s ease 0.24s both;
}
.music-player-hint {
  padding: 26px 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.music-player-frame iframe { width: 100%; height: 352px; border: none; display: block; }

.widget-music { border-color: var(--accent); }
.widget-music-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  margin: 4px 0 8px;
}
.widget-music-cover {
  position: relative; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 80%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: grid; place-items: center;
}
.widget-music-cover img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.widget-music-glyph { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--accent); }
.widget-music-meta {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0;
}
.widget-music-meta #widget-music-title {
  font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text);
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.widget-music-meta #widget-music-sub { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); }
.widget-music-eq { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 3px; height: 14px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.widget-music-eq span {
  width: 4px; height: 6px; border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--accent);
  animation: widget-eq 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.widget-music-eq span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.18s; }
.widget-music-eq span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.36s; }
@keyframes widget-eq {
  0%, 100% { height: 4px; opacity: 0.6; }
  50% { height: 14px; opacity: 1; }
}
.widget-toggle-note { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; }

.music-results {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
  animation: fadein 0.35s ease both;
}
.music-results-empty {
  padding: 18px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.92rem;
}
.music-track {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 78%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}
.music-track:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateX(2px); }
.music-track img {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 8px; object-fit: cover; flex: none;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
}
.music-track-meta { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.music-track-title {
  font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.music-track-sub {
  font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted);
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.music-track-time {
  flex: none; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.music-track-spotify {
  flex: none; font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
  padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px;
  transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.music-track-spotify:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--accent); }
.music-track-play {
  flex: none; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-contrast);
  border: none; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.music-track-play:hover { transform: scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--glow); }
.music-track-play.playing { animation: soft-glow 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }

.music-preview-bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}
.music-preview-dot {
  flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent);
  animation: soft-glow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.music-preview-bar #music-preview-title {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
}
#music-preview-stop {
  flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 0.7rem; line-height: 1;
  background: transparent; color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}
#music-preview-stop:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }

.settings-card {
  animation: rise-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.settings-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
.settings-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.11s; }
.settings-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.17s; }
.settings-card:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.23s; }
.settings-card:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.29s; }
.settings-card:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.35s; }
.settings-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

.theme-swatch {
  transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease;
}
.theme-swatch:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.03); }
.theme-swatch:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

.ghost-btn, .upload-btn {
  transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease;
}
.ghost-btn:hover, .upload-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.ghost-btn:active, .upload-btn:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); }

.nav-item {
  transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease;
}
.nav-item:hover { transform: translateX(3px); }

#sj-form { transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); }
#sj-form:focus-within { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01); }
#sj-address { transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; }

.frame-exit { animation: rise-in 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); }
.frame-exit:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

@keyframes soft-glow {
  0%, 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--glow); }
  50% { text-shadow: 0 0 34px var(--glow); }
}
.hero-clock-time { animation: rise-in 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both, soft-glow 4s ease-in-out 1s infinite; }

.music-card, .music-player, .music-cat, .music-add, .chat-auth, .chat-room, .chat-msg { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
  .music-card, .music-card-cover img, .music-cat { transition: none !important; }
}

.app {
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
  display: flex; min-height: 100vh;
}

.sidebar {
  width: var(--side-w); flex: 0 0 var(--side-w);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  padding: 22px 14px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elev) 82%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh;
}

.sidebar-logo {
  font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  padding: 0 10px 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  text-shadow: 0 0 22px var(--glow);
}

.side-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

.nav-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 10px;
  background: none; border: 1px solid transparent;
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.nav-item svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: 0 0 19px; }
.nav-item:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--glow); }
.nav-item.active {
  color: var(--accent); background: var(--glow);
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.sidebar-foot {
  margin-top: auto; padding: 12px 10px 0;
  font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.view { display: none; padding: 34px 40px 60px; animation: fadein 0.25s ease; }
.view.active { display: block; }

@keyframes fadein {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

.view-head { margin-bottom: 22px; }
.view-head h2 { font-size: 1.55rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 6px; }

.view-home { min-height: calc(100vh - 60px); }

.logo {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 4.6rem);
  font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  text-align: center; margin: 9vh 0 34px;
  text-shadow: 0 0 42px var(--glow);
  display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; padding: 0 8px 6px;
}

#sj-form { display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 26px; }

#sj-address {
  width: min(620px, 90%);
  padding: 15px 20px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 80%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px;
  color: var(--text); font-size: 1rem; font-family: inherit;
  outline: none; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
#sj-address::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
#sj-address:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--glow);
}

.shortcuts {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.shortcuts button {
  padding: 11px 22px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 78%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text); font-size: 0.92rem; font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.shortcuts button:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--glow);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

#sj-error { text-align: center; color: var(--accent); min-height: 1.4em; margin-top: 8px; }
#sj-error-code {
  text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.8rem;
  white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all;
}

.games-wrap {
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-elev);
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--glow);
}
#games-frame { width: 100%; height: calc(100vh - 210px); border: none; display: block; }

.games-head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.games-head .ghost-btn { flex: none; margin-bottom: 22px; }

.games-wrap:fullscreen {
  border: none; border-radius: 0; background: var(--bg);
  box-shadow: none;
}
.games-wrap:fullscreen #games-frame { height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; }

.apps-wrap {
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden;
  background: #050505;
}
#apps-frame { width: 100%; height: calc(100vh - 210px); border: none; display: block; }
.apps-head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.apps-head .ghost-btn { flex: none; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.apps-wrap:fullscreen { border: none; border-radius: 0; background: #050505; }
.apps-wrap:fullscreen #apps-frame { height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; }

.ghost-btn, .upload-btn {
  padding: 11px 20px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.92rem; font-family: inherit;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  background: transparent; color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.ghost-btn:hover, .upload-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }

.settings-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px; max-width: 1100px;
}
.settings-card {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 88%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 22px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.settings-card h3 { font-size: 1.08rem; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.settings-card > .muted { font-size: 0.86rem; margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 1.45; }

.theme-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; }

.theme-swatch {
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 6px 8px; cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: inherit;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.theme-swatch:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.theme-swatch.active { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--glow); }
.theme-swatch .swatch {
  width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}
.theme-swatch span { font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--muted); }
.theme-swatch.active span { color: var(--text); }

.upload-btn { display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.settings-card .upload-btn + .ghost-btn { margin-left: 8px; }

.wallpaper-preview {
  margin-top: 14px; height: 110px; border-radius: 10px;
  background-size: cover; background-position: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

select {
  width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
  font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.92rem; cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
}
select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

.cloak-custom-row {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px;
}
.cloak-custom-row input {
  padding: 11px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
  font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.cloak-custom-row input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
.cloak-custom-row input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--glow); }
.cloak-custom-row .ghost-btn { align-self: flex-start; }
.cloak-about-row { margin-top: 10px; }
.cloak-panic-row { margin-top: 10px; }
.cloak-panic-toggle {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}
.cloak-panic-toggle input { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: var(--accent); flex: none; }
.cloak-panic-keyrow {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
.cloak-panic-keyrow .ghost-btn { padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 0.82rem; }
.cloak-panic-keyrow .ghost-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }
.cloak-panic-current { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted); }
.cloak-panic-current kbd, .cloak-panic-current code {
  padding: 1px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom-width: 2px;
  border-radius: 5px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; background: var(--bg-elev);
  color: var(--text);
}

.frame-exit {
  position: fixed; top: 14px; right: 16px; z-index: 3000;
  padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elev) 85%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text);
  font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.frame-exit:hover { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--glow); }

html[data-theme^="glass"] {
  --glass-tint: rgba(10, 10, 14, 0.42);
  --glass-tint-soft: rgba(10, 10, 14, 0.28);
  --glass-tint-strong: rgba(10, 10, 14, 0.55);
  --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  --glass-border-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13);
  --glass-highlight: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  --glass-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] body {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #06060a 0%, #0d0d15 55%, #12101c 100%);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .sidebar {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--glass-tint), var(--glass-tint-soft));
  backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.6);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--glass-border-soft);
  box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .nav-item.active {
  background: var(--glass-tint-strong);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] #sj-address {
  background: var(--glass-tint);
  backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.5);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight), 0 14px 40px var(--glass-shadow);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .shortcuts button {
  background: var(--glass-tint);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .settings-card {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--glass-tint-strong), var(--glass-tint-soft));
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 60px var(--glass-shadow), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .theme-swatch.active {
  background: var(--glass-tint-strong);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--glass-border), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .ghost-btn,
html[data-theme^="glass"] .upload-btn {
  background: var(--glass-tint);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.4);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] select {
  background: var(--glass-tint);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .frame-exit {
  background: var(--glass-tint-strong);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .games-wrap {
  background: var(--glass-tint-soft);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5);
  border-color: var(--glass-border-soft);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .widget {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--glass-tint-strong), var(--glass-tint-soft));
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 46px var(--glass-shadow), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight);
}

html[data-theme^="glass"] .widget-todo-row input[type="text"] {
  background: var(--glass-tint);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
}

.hero-clock {
  text-align: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.hero-clock-time {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 9vw, 5.5rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1;
}
html[data-theme^="glass"] .hero-clock-time {
  text-shadow: 0 2px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.hero-clock-date { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 8px; }

.hero-quote {
  max-width: 560px; margin: 22px auto 0; text-align: center; position: relative; z-index: 1;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease, transform 0.35s ease;
}
.hero-quote.fading {
  opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px);
}
.hero-quote-text {
  font-size: 1.02rem; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--text);
}
.hero-quote-author {
  display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
html[data-theme^="glass"] .hero-quote-text { text-shadow: 0 1px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }

.widget .widget-big-num { font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.widget .widget-sub { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }

.widget-quicklinks-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.widget-quicklinks-list button {
  background: var(--glass-tint-soft, var(--bg-elev)); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem;
  padding: 4px 11px; cursor: pointer;
}
.widget-quicklinks-list button:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.widget-quicklinks-add { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
.widget-quicklinks-add input {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 9px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; outline: none;
}
.widget-quicklinks-add button {
  background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 9px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.widget-quicklinks-list li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.widget-quicklinks-list .ql-del {
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.7rem;
  margin-left: 4px; padding: 2px;
}
.widget-quicklinks-list .ql-del:hover { color: var(--text); }

.widget-calendar-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.widget-calendar-head strong { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; }
.widget-calendar-head button {
  background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--text);
  cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 2px 8px;
}
.widget-calendar-head button:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.widget-calendar-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 2px; text-align: center;
}
.widget-calendar-grid .cal-dow { font-size: 0.62rem; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 0; }
.widget-calendar-grid .cal-day { font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 3px 0; border-radius: 6px; }
.widget-calendar-grid .cal-day.today { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-contrast); font-weight: 700; }
.widget-calendar-grid .cal-day.dim { opacity: 0.35; }

.widget-stopwatch-controls { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
.widget-stopwatch-controls button {
  background: var(--glass-tint-soft, var(--bg-elev)); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 4px 12px;
}
.widget-stopwatch-controls button:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }

.widget-battery-bar {
  height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--glass-tint-soft, var(--bg-elev));
  border: 1px solid var(--border); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 10px;
}
.widget-battery-fill {
  height: 100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 999px;
  transition: width 0.4s ease;
}

.widgets {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px; max-width: 640px; margin: 26px auto 0; width: 100%;
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
}
.widgets[hidden] { display: none; }
.widget {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 14px 16px; text-align: left;
}
.widget h4 {
  font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 600;
}
.widget-clock-time { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.widget-clock-date { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.widget-notes textarea {
  width: 100%; min-height: 96px; resize: vertical;
  background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: var(--text);
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5;
}
.widget-todo-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.widget-todo-row input[type="text"] {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; outline: none;
}
.widget-todo-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-height: 140px; overflow-y: auto; }
.widget-todo-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.88rem; }
.widget-todo-list li.done span { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: 0.5; }
.widget-todo-list li span { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.widget-todo-list li button {
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 2px 4px;
}
.widget-todo-list li button:hover { color: var(--text); }

.widget-toggle {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 7px 0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.93rem;
}
.widget-toggle input { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: var(--accent); }

.chat-auth[hidden], .chat-room[hidden] { display: none; }

.chat-auth {
  max-width: 420px; margin: 8px auto 0;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 78%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  animation: rise-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
}
.chat-auth form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 26px; }
.chat-auth h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.chat-auth .muted { font-size: 0.85rem; }
.chat-auth input {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 80%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--text); font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: inherit; outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.chat-auth input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
.chat-auth input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--glow); }
.chat-auth-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 2px; }
.chat-auth-actions .ghost-btn { flex: 1; }
.chat-auth-error { min-height: 1.2em; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #ff7d9c; }
.chat-auth .ghost-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: wait; }

.chat-room {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  height: calc(100vh - 220px); min-height: 420px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 78%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  animation: rise-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
}
.chat-room-head {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.chat-you { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--muted); }
.chat-you strong { color: var(--text); }
.chat-online {
  flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted);
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.chat-online.active { color: var(--accent); }
.chat-room-head .ghost-btn { padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 0.8rem; }

.chat-log {
  flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 18px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}
.chat-msg {
  max-width: 78%; align-self: flex-start;
  padding: 9px 13px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elev) 88%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px 12px 12px 4px;
  animation: fadein 0.25s ease both;
}
.chat-msg-head {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.chat-msg-user { font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.chat-msg-head time { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); }
.chat-msg-guest {
  font-size: 0.62rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 6px;
}
.chat-msg-text {
  display: block; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.4;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.chat-compose {
  display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.chat-compose input {
  flex: 1; padding: 12px 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 80%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--text); font-size: 0.93rem; font-family: inherit; outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.chat-compose input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
.chat-compose input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--glow); }

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .app { flex-direction: column; }
  .sidebar {
    width: 100%; flex: none; height: auto; position: static;
    flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px;
    border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .sidebar-logo { border-bottom: none; padding: 0 6px 0 0; margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; }
  .side-nav { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .sidebar-foot { display: none; }
  .view { padding: 22px 18px 40px; }
  #games-frame { height: calc(100vh - 280px); }
  .chat-room { height: calc(100vh - 300px); }
  .chat-msg { max-width: 92%; }
}

.widget-music {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 45%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12));
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5);
  box-shadow:
    0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}
.widget-music::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 60% at 20% 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(90% 55% at 90% 110%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), transparent 60%);
}
.widget-music > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.widget-music h4 {
  text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.widget-music-cover {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.widget-music-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.widget-music-controls button {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 7px 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--text);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
}
.widget-music-controls button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); }
.widget-music-controls button:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
.widget-music-seek {
  height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.widget-music-seek-fill {
  height: 100%; width: 0%; border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55));
}
.widget-music widget-music-glass-fallback, .widget-music .widget-music-glyph { text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }

html.glass-mode .widget,
html.glass-mode .settings-card,
html.glass-mode .music-player,
html.glass-mode .chat-auth,
html.glass-mode .sidebar {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05));
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
}

html[style*="--accent"] .theme-swatch.active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent); }

html.compact .widget { padding: 10px 12px; }
html.compact .view { padding: 18px 22px 30px; }
html.compact .hero-clock-time { font-size: 2.6rem; }

html.icons-sidebar .nav-item span { display: none; }
html.icons-sidebar .sidebar { width: 64px; }
html.icons-sidebar .main { margin-left: 64px; }
html.icons-sidebar .nav-item { justify-content: center; padding: 10px 0; }
html.icons-sidebar .sidebar-logo { font-size: 1rem; }

#particles-canvas {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5;
}
html.particles-on #particles-canvas { display: block; }
#particles-canvas { display: none; }

html.wallpaper-blur .wallpaper { filter: blur(14px) brightness(0.9); transform: scale(1.06); }

.greeting { text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-top: -6px; }

.wallpaper-presets { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; }
.wallpaper-presets button {
  width: 44px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 0;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.wallpaper-presets button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--accent); }

.accent-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.accent-row button {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 2px solid transparent; padding: 0;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.accent-row button:hover { transform: scale(1.12); }
.accent-row button.active { border-color: var(--text); }

.shortcut-tools { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; margin-top: -8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.shortcut-tools .ghost-btn { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 0.8rem; }

.music-controls-row {
  display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.music-controls-row .ghost-btn { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.music-controls-row .ghost-btn.on { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.music-speed-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); }
.music-speed-label select {
  background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.music-recent { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.music-recent-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); }
.music-recent-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.music-recent-chips button {
  padding: 5px 11px; font-size: 0.78rem; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 80%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); font-family: inherit;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}
.music-recent-chips button:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-1px); }

.widget-currency-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.widget-currency-row input, .widget-currency-row select {
  min-width: 0; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text); font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.widget-currency-row input { width: 70px; }
.widget-currency-row button {
  padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); font-family: inherit;
}
#widget-countdown-date, #widget-countdown-label, #widget-habits-input, #timer-alarm-input {
  width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text); font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem;
}
.widget-habits-list { list-style: none; margin: 6px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.widget-habits-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem; }
.widget-habits-list li.done { opacity: 0.55; text-decoration: line-through; }
.widget-habits-list .habit-streak { margin-left: auto; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.72rem; }
.widget-habits-list .habit-del { background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.75rem; }

.chat-typing {
  min-height: 18px; padding: 0 4px 6px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted);
  font-style: italic;
}
.chat-typing:empty { display: none; }

.palette-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 4000;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center;
  padding-top: 14vh;
}
.palette-overlay[hidden] { display: none; }
.palette {
  width: min(560px, 92vw);
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 30, 30, 0.92), rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.92));
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.palette input {
  width: 100%; padding: 16px 18px; border: none; outline: none;
  background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-size: 1rem; font-family: inherit;
}
.palette-list { max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto; }
.palette-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text);
}
.palette-item .palette-key {
  margin-left: auto; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px;
}
.palette-item.active, .palette-item:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); }
.palette-empty { padding: 18px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.88rem; text-align: center; }
.palette-hint {
  padding: 8px 18px 12px; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.haze-modal-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 4200;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.haze-modal {
  width: min(480px, 92vw); max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto;
  border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px;
  background: var(--bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.haze-modal h3 { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.haze-modal ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.haze-modal li { font-size: 0.85rem; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; }
.haze-modal li time { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.75rem; flex: none; }
.haze-modal li button { margin-left: auto; background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; }
.haze-modal .modal-close { margin-top: 14px; }

.haze-toast {
  position: fixed; bottom: 22px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 5000; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.92); color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  animation: rise-in 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.settings-card select {
  width: 100%; margin-top: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text); border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 10px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.88rem;
}
.settings-card input[type="text"], .settings-card input[type="time"] {
  background: var(--bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text); border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 10px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.widget-music.sleep-armed { animation: soft-glow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .widget-music-eq span { animation: none; }
}

.widget-music-vol {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 10px;
}
.widget-music-vol button {
  background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px;
  font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--text); opacity: 0.85;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease;
}
.widget-music-vol button:hover { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.12); }
.widget-music-vol button.muted { opacity: 0.45; }
.widget-music-vol button#widget-music-like { margin-left: auto; }
.widget-music-vol button#widget-music-like.active { color: #ff5c7a; opacity: 1; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 92, 122, 0.6); }
.widget-music-vol input[type="range"],
.music-speed-label input[type="range"] {
  -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
  width: 92px; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent, #fff) var(--fill, 90%), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) var(--fill, 90%));
  outline: none; cursor: pointer;
}
.widget-music-vol input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb,
.music-speed-label input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
  width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff; border: none;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease;
}
.widget-music-vol input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover,
.music-speed-label input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover { transform: scale(1.25); }
.widget-music-vol input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb,
.music-speed-label input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; border: none;
}

.side-jump {
  display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;
  padding: 10px 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); margin-top: 8px;
}
html.jump-sidebar .side-jump { display: flex; }
.side-jump-item {
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.8rem; font-family: inherit;
  transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, padding-left 0.15s ease;
}
.side-jump-item:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: var(--text); padding-left: 14px;
}
html.icons-sidebar .side-jump-item { font-size: 0.62rem; padding: 5px 4px; text-align: center; }

html.opaque-mode .widget,
html.opaque-mode .settings-card,
html.opaque-mode .haze-modal,
html.opaque-mode .palette,
html.opaque-mode .sidebar,
html.opaque-mode .haze-toast {
  background: var(--bg-elev) !important;
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) !important;
}
html.opaque-mode .widget-music::before { display: none !important; }

html.webgl-tilt .settings-card,
html.webgl-tilt .widget {
  transition: transform 0.18s ease-out;
  will-change: transform;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html.webgl-tilt .settings-card,
  html.webgl-tilt .widget { transition: none; transform: none !important; }
}

.chat-msg.chat-action .chat-msg-text {
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.di {
  position: fixed;
  top: 14px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 70;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  background: rgba(10, 10, 12, 0.92);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), padding 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.di:hover { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.04); }
.di:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.97); }
.di-time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
.di-sep { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); flex: none; }
.di-wx { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
.di-emoji { font-size: 15px; }
.di-more {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  max-width: 0; opacity: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: max-width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), opacity 0.25s ease;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.di.open { padding: 10px 20px; }
.di.open .di-more { max-width: 340px; opacity: 1; }
.di-small { font-size: 11.5px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55); font-weight: 500; }

.ai-wrap {
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
  overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-elev);
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--glow);
}
#ai-frame { width: 100%; height: calc(100vh - 210px); border: none; display: block; }

.ai-head {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.ai-head .ghost-btn { flex: none; margin-bottom: 22px; }

.ai-wrap:fullscreen {
  border: none; border-radius: 0; background: var(--bg);
  box-shadow: none;
}
.ai-wrap:fullscreen #ai-frame { height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; }

.view-ai { padding-top: 20px; padding-bottom: 0; }
.view-ai .ai-head { margin-bottom: 0; }
.view-ai .ai-head .ghost-btn { margin-bottom: 0; }
.ai-wrap { height: calc(100vh - 120px); border-radius: 16px; }
#ai-frame { height: 100%; }
html.compact .ai-wrap { height: calc(100vh - 92px); }
html.glass-mode .ai-wrap { border-radius: 22px; }

body.ai-immerse .view-ai .view-head { display: none; }
body.ai-immerse .ai-wrap {
  height: calc(100vh - 40px);
  border-radius: 0;
  border: none;
}
body.ai-immerse #ai-frame { height: 100%; }

body.fullbleed .sidebar ~ main .view-head { display: none; }
body.fullbleed .games-wrap,
body.fullbleed .apps-wrap {
  height: calc(100vh - 40px);
  border-radius: 0;
  border: none;
}
body.fullbleed #games-frame,
body.fullbleed #apps-frame { height: 100%; }
body.fullbleed .music-head,
body.fullbleed .games-head,
body.fullbleed .apps-head { display: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="glass-blobs" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  <div class="grid-overlay" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="wallpaper" id="wallpaper" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <button class="di" id="di" type="button" title="Time & weather — click to expand">
    <span class="di-time" id="di-time">--:--</span>
    <span class="di-sep"></span>
    <span class="di-wx" id="di-wx" style="display:none"><span class="di-emoji" id="di-emoji"></span><span id="di-temp"></span></span>
    <span class="di-more" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="di-small" id="di-date"></span>
      <span class="di-small" id="di-cond"></span>
      <span class="di-small" id="di-hl"></span>
    </span>
  </button>

  <div class="app">
    <aside class="sidebar">
      <div class="sidebar-logo">haze</div>
      <nav class="side-nav">
        <button class="nav-item active" data-view="home" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 10.5 12 3l9 7.5"/><path d="M5 9.5V21h14V9.5"/><path d="M9 21v-6h6v6"/></svg>
          <span>Home</span>
        </button>
        <button class="nav-item" data-view="games" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 12h4m-2-2v4"/><path d="M15.5 11h.01M18 13h.01"/><path d="M17.3 5H6.7a4.7 4.7 0 0 0-4.6 5.6l1 5.2A3 3 0 0 0 8 17.5l1.5-1.5h5L16 17.5a3 3 0 0 0 4.9-1.7l1-5.2A4.7 4.7 0 0 0 17.3 5Z"/></svg>
          <span>haze games</span>
        </button>
        <button class="nav-item" data-view="music" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"/></svg>
          <span>Music</span>
        </button>
        <button class="nav-item" data-view="ai" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 8V4H8"/><rect x="4" y="8" width="16" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M2 14h2"/><path d="M20 14h2"/><path d="M15 13v2"/><path d="M9 13v2"/></svg>
          <span>AI</span>
        </button>
        <button class="nav-item" data-view="chat" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>
          <span>Chat</span>
        </button>
        <button class="nav-item" data-view="apps" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/></svg>
          <span>Apps</span>
        </button>
        <button class="nav-item" data-view="settings" type="button">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1-1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51-1 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83-2.83l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33h.01a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51h.01a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82v.01a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1Z"/></svg>
          <span>Settings</span>
        </button>
      </nav>
      <div class="sidebar-foot" id="engine-foot">haze</div>
    </aside>

    <main class="main">
      <!-- PAGE: home -->
      <section class="view view-home active" data-view-section="home">
        <div class="hero-clock">
          <div class="hero-clock-time" id="hero-clock-time">--:--</div>
          <div class="hero-clock-date" id="hero-clock-date"></div>
        </div>

        <h1 class="logo">haze</h1>
        <p class="greeting" id="greeting" hidden></p>

        <div class="hero-quote" id="hero-quote">
          <span class="hero-quote-text" id="hero-quote-text"></span>
          <span class="hero-quote-author" id="hero-quote-author"></span>
        </div>

        <form id="sj-form" autocomplete="off">
          <input
            id="sj-search-engine"
            value="https://search.brave.com/search?q=%s"
            type="hidden"
          />
          <input id="sj-address" type="text" placeholder="Search Brave or type a URL" autofocus />
        </form>

        <nav class="shortcuts" id="shortcuts">
          <button data-url="https://www.youtube.com" type="button">YouTube</button>
          <button data-url="https://discord.com" type="button">Discord</button>
          <button data-url="https://open.spotify.com" type="button">Spotify</button>
          <button data-url="https://www.tiktok.com" type="button">TikTok</button>
        </nav>
        <div class="shortcut-tools">
          <button id="shortcut-random" class="ghost-btn" type="button" title="Open a random site from the pinned list"> Surprise me </button>
          <button id="shortcut-shuffle" class="ghost-btn" type="button" title="Shuffle the pinned shortcuts order"> Shuffle </button>
          <button id="shortcut-edit" class="ghost-btn" type="button" title="Pin more sites in Settings"> Edit pins </button>
        </div>

        <div class="widgets" id="widgets" hidden>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-clock" hidden>
            <h4>Clock</h4>
            <div class="widget-clock-time" id="widget-clock-time">--:--</div>
            <div class="widget-clock-date" id="widget-clock-date"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-notes" hidden>
            <h4>Notes</h4>
            <textarea id="widget-notes-area" placeholder="Jot something down..."></textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-todo" hidden>
            <h4>To-do</h4>
            <div class="widget-todo-row">
              <input id="widget-todo-input" type="text" placeholder="Add a task..." />
              <button id="widget-todo-add" class="ghost-btn" type="button">+</button>
            </div>
            <ul class="widget-todo-list" id="widget-todo-list"></ul>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-quicklinks" hidden>
            <h4>Quick links</h4>
            <ul class="widget-quicklinks-list" id="widget-quicklinks-list"></ul>
            <div class="widget-quicklinks-add">
              <input id="widget-quicklinks-url" type="text" placeholder="example.com" />
              <button id="widget-quicklinks-add" type="button">+</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-calendar" hidden>
            <div class="widget-calendar-head">
              <strong id="widget-calendar-label"></strong>
              <span>
                <button id="widget-calendar-prev" type="button" title="Previous month">‹</button>
                <button id="widget-calendar-next" type="button" title="Next month">›</button>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div class="widget-calendar-grid" id="widget-calendar-grid"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-stopwatch" hidden>
            <h4>Stopwatch</h4>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-stopwatch-time">00:00.0</div>
            <div class="widget-stopwatch-controls">
              <button id="widget-stopwatch-start" type="button">Start</button>
              <button id="widget-stopwatch-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-battery" hidden>
            <h4>Battery</h4>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-battery-level">--%</div>
            <div class="widget-sub" id="widget-battery-status"></div>
            <div class="widget-battery-bar"><div class="widget-battery-fill" id="widget-battery-fill" style="width:0%"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-pomodoro" hidden>
            <h4>Focus timer</h4>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-pomodoro-time">25:00</div>
            <div class="widget-sub" id="widget-pomodoro-phase">Focus</div>
            <div class="widget-stopwatch-controls">
              <button id="widget-pomodoro-start" type="button">Start</button>
              <button id="widget-pomodoro-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-weather" hidden>
            <h4>Weather</h4>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-weather-temp">--°</div>
            <div class="widget-sub" id="widget-weather-desc">Locating…</div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-currency" hidden>
            <h4>Currency</h4>
            <div class="widget-currency-row">
              <input id="widget-currency-amount" type="number" value="100" min="0" />
              <select id="widget-currency-from"></select>
              <span>→</span>
              <select id="widget-currency-to"></select>
            </div>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-currency-result">—</div>
            <div class="widget-sub" id="widget-currency-rate"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-countdown" hidden>
            <h4>Countdown</h4>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-countdown-time">--</div>
            <input id="widget-countdown-date" type="datetime-local" />
            <input id="widget-countdown-label" type="text" placeholder="What are you waiting for?" maxlength="40" />
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-passgen" hidden>
            <h4>Password generator</h4>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-passgen-out">······</div>
            <div class="widget-stopwatch-controls">
              <button id="widget-passgen-new" type="button">New</button>
              <select id="widget-passgen-len">
                <option value="12">12</option>
                <option value="16" selected>16</option>
                <option value="20">20</option>
                <option value="24">24</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-habits" hidden>
            <h4>Habit tracker</h4>
            <div class="widget-sub" id="widget-habits-summary">No habits yet</div>
            <ul class="widget-habits-list" id="widget-habits-list"></ul>
            <div class="widget-quicklinks-add">
              <input id="widget-habits-input" type="text" placeholder="New habit..." maxlength="30" />
              <button id="widget-habits-add" type="button">+</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-dice" hidden>
            <h4>Dice</h4>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-dice-face">🎲</div>
            <div class="widget-stopwatch-controls">
              <button id="widget-dice-roll" type="button">Roll</button>
              <select id="widget-dice-sides"><option value="6">d6</option><option value="4">d4</option><option value="8">d8</option><option value="12">d12</option><option value="20">d20</option><option value="100">d100</option></select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-worldclock" hidden>
            <h4>World clock</h4>
            <div class="widget-sub">Local: <span id="widget-worldclock-local"></span></div>
            <div class="widget-sub">New York: <span id="widget-worldclock-ny"></span></div>
            <div class="widget-sub">London: <span id="widget-worldclock-lon"></span></div>
            <div class="widget-sub">Tokyo: <span id="widget-worldclock-tok"></span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-timer" hidden>
            <h4>Timer</h4>
            <div class="widget-big-num" id="widget-timer-time">00:00</div>
            <div class="widget-currency-row">
              <input id="widget-timer-min" type="number" min="0" max="180" value="5" title="minutes" />
              <input id="widget-timer-sec" type="number" min="0" max="59" value="0" title="seconds" />
              <button id="widget-timer-start" type="button">Go</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-ip" hidden>
            <h4>Connection</h4>
            <div class="widget-sub" id="widget-ip-addr">IP: …</div>
            <div class="widget-sub" id="widget-ip-net"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget" id="widget-quote" hidden>
            <h4>Daily quote</h4>
            <div class="widget-sub" id="widget-quote-text">…</div>
          </div>
          <div class="widget widget-music" id="widget-music" hidden>
            <h4>Now playing</h4>
            <div class="widget-music-row">
              <span class="widget-music-cover">
                <img alt="" hidden />
                <span class="widget-music-glyph">\u266b</span>
              </span>
              <span class="widget-music-meta">
                <span id="widget-music-title"></span>
                <span id="widget-music-sub"></span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div class="widget-music-seek"><div class="widget-music-seek-fill" id="widget-music-seek-fill"></div></div>
            <div class="widget-music-eq" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
            <div class="widget-music-controls">
              <button id="widget-music-prev" type="button" title="Previous">⏮</button>
              <button id="widget-music-playpause" type="button" title="Pause / resume">⏸</button>
              <button id="widget-music-next" type="button" title="Next">⏭</button>
              <button id="widget-music-stop" type="button" title="Stop">■</button>
            </div>
            <div class="widget-music-vol">
              <button id="widget-music-mute" type="button" title="Mute (M)">🔊</button>
              <input id="widget-music-vol" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="90" title="Volume" />
              <button id="widget-music-like" type="button" title="Love this song (L)">♡</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <p id="sj-error"></p>
        <pre id="sj-error-code"></pre>
      </section>

      <!-- PAGE: haze games -->
      <section class="view view-games" data-view-section="games">
        <div class="view-head games-head">
          <div>
            <h2>haze games</h2>
            <p class="muted">Hundreds of browser games, built in. Runs natively — no proxy needed.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="games-wrap">
          <iframe id="games-frame" title="haze games"></iframe>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- PAGE: music -->
      <section class="view view-music" data-view-section="music">
        <div class="view-head music-head">
          <div>
            <h2>Music</h2>
            <p class="muted">Real Spotify playlists and a real song search — no account, keys or proxy needed.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="music-toolbar">
          <div class="music-cats" id="music-cats" role="tablist" aria-label="Playlist categories"></div>
          <form id="music-add-form" class="music-add" autocomplete="off">
            <input id="music-add-input" type="text" placeholder="Search any song by name..." />
            <button class="ghost-btn" type="submit">Search</button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div class="music-controls-row">
          <button id="music-shuffle" class="ghost-btn" type="button" title="Play search results in random order"> Shuffle results</button>
          <button id="music-repeat" class="ghost-btn" type="button" title="Repeat the queue"> Repeat: off</button>
          <button id="music-sleep" class="ghost-btn" type="button" title="Fade music out and stop"> Sleep timer</button>
          <label class="music-speed-label">Speed
            <select id="music-speed">
              <option value="0.75">0.75×</option>
              <option value="1" selected>1×</option>
              <option value="1.25">1.25×</option>
              <option value="1.5">1.5×</option>
              <option value="2">2×</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label class="music-speed-label" title="Volume (M to mute)">Vol
            <input id="music-volume" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="90" />
          </label>
        </div>

        <div class="music-recent" id="music-recent" hidden>
          <span class="music-recent-label">Recently played</span>
          <div class="music-recent-chips" id="music-recent-chips"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="music-results" id="music-results" hidden></div>

        <div class="music-grid" id="music-grid"></div>

        <div class="music-player">
          <div class="music-preview-bar" id="music-preview-bar" hidden>
            <span class="music-preview-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span id="music-preview-title"></span>
            <button id="music-preview-stop" type="button" title="Stop preview">■</button>
          </div>
          <p class="music-player-hint" id="music-player-hint">Pick a playlist above, or search a song — it plays right here.</p>
          <div class="music-player-frame" id="music-player-frame" hidden></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- PAGE: chat -->
      <section class="view view-chat" data-view-section="chat">
        <div class="view-head">
          <h2>Chat</h2>
          <p class="muted">One global room for everyone using this haze server. Pick a name + password to join.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="chat-auth" id="chat-auth">
          <form id="chat-auth-form" autocomplete="off">
            <h3>Join the room</h3>
            <p class="muted">New name creates an account; existing name logs you in.</p>
            <input id="chat-name" type="text" placeholder="Username (3-16 chars)" maxlength="16" />
            <input id="chat-password" type="password" placeholder="Password (4+ chars)" maxlength="72" />
            <div class="chat-auth-actions">
              <button class="ghost-btn" id="chat-auth-submit" type="submit">Join</button>
              <button class="ghost-btn" id="chat-guest-btn" type="button">Join as guest</button>
            </div>
            <p class="chat-auth-error" id="chat-auth-error"></p>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div class="chat-room" id="chat-room" hidden>
          <div class="chat-room-head">
            <span class="chat-you">Speaking as <strong id="chat-you-name"></strong></span>
