            <span class="chat-online" id="chat-online" title="People active in the last 15 seconds"></span>
            <button class="ghost-btn" id="chat-logout" type="button">Log out</button>
          </div>
          <div class="chat-log" id="chat-log" aria-live="polite"></div>
          <form class="chat-compose" id="chat-form" autocomplete="off">
            <input id="chat-input" type="text" placeholder="Say something to the room..." maxlength="500" />
            <button class="ghost-btn" type="submit">Send</button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- PAGE: ai -->
      <section class="view view-ai" data-view-section="ai">
        <div class="view-head ai-head">
          <div>
            <h2>AI</h2>
            <p class="muted">Chat with 18+ models — free ones work with no key at all; drop in API keys for the premium ones.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="ai-wrap">
          <iframe id="ai-frame" title="haze AI"></iframe>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- PAGE: apps -->
      <section class="view view-apps" data-view-section="apps">
        <div class="view-head apps-head">
          <div>
            <h2>Apps</h2>
            <p class="muted">25,000+ sites as one-tap app tiles — opening in a full-screen frame.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="apps-wrap">
          <iframe id="apps-frame" title="haze apps"></iframe>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- PAGE: settings -->
      <section class="view view-settings" data-view-section="settings">
        <div class="view-head">
          <h2>Settings</h2>
          <p class="muted">Everything is saved locally on this device.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="settings-grid">
          <div class="settings-card">
            <h3>Theme</h3>
            <p class="muted">Change how haze looks.</p>
            <div class="theme-grid" id="theme-grid"></div>
          </div>

          <div class="settings-card">
            <h3>Wallpaper</h3>
            <p class="muted">Upload your own background image.</p>
            <label class="upload-btn">
              Upload your own
              <input id="wallpaper-input" type="file" accept="image/*" hidden />
            </label>
            <button id="wallpaper-clear" class="ghost-btn" type="button" hidden>Remove wallpaper</button>
            <div id="wallpaper-preview" class="wallpaper-preview" hidden></div>
            <div class="wallpaper-presets" id="wallpaper-presets"></div>
            <label class="widget-toggle"><input id="wallpaper-blur-toggle" type="checkbox" /> Blur wallpaper</label>
          </div>

          <div class="settings-card">
            <h3>Search engine</h3>
            <p class="muted">Used when you type a search instead of a URL. Brave is the default.</p>
            <select id="engine-select">
              <option value="brave">Brave (default)</option>
              <option value="google">Google</option>
              <option value="duckduckgo">DuckDuckGo</option>
              <option value="bing">Bing</option>
              <option value="startpage">Startpage</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="settings-card" hidden style="display:none">
            <h3>Proxy engine</h3>
            <p class="muted">How sites load inside the frame. Switching reloads haze.</p>
            <select id="proxy-engine-select">
              <option value="scramjet">Scramjet v2 (default)</option>
              <option value="ultraviolet">Ultraviolet</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div class="settings-card">
            <h3>Appearance</h3>
            <p class="muted">Accent color, transparency and motion.</p>
            <div class="cloak-custom-row">
              <label class="music-speed-label">Font
                <select id="font-select">
                  <option value="system">System (default)</option>
                  <option value="outfit">Outfit</option>
                  <option value="fredoka">Fredoka</option>

<!-- PAGE: games frame -->
<template id="page-games">
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    :root {
      --ga: #ffffff;              
      --ga-ink: #0a0a0a;
      --pill: #0f0f0f;
      --pill-brd: #262626;
      --muted: #9a9a9a;
    }
    html { scrollbar-color: #333 #050505; }
    body {
      background: #050505; color: #f5f5f5;
      font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      padding: 14px 18px 86px; 
    }

    .g-nav {
      position: sticky; top: 12px; z-index: 20;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.92);
      border: 1px solid var(--pill-brd); border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 5px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }
    .g-nav .g-logo {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--ga); color: var(--ga-ink);
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; border: none; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .g-nav .g-logo:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
    .g-nav .g-div { width: 1px; height: 18px; background: #2a2a2a; margin: 0 3px; }
    .g-nav button.g-ico, .g-nav label.g-search {
      height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: transparent;
      color: #e8e8e8; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0 12px; transition: background 0.15s ease;
    }
    .g-nav button.g-ico:hover, .g-nav label.g-search:hover { background: #1d1d1d; }
    .g-nav button.g-ico.on { background: #242424; }
    .g-nav label.g-search { cursor: text; }
    .g-nav input {
      background: transparent; border: none; outline: none;
      color: #f5f5f5; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; width: 150px;
    }
    .g-nav input::placeholder { color: #6e6e6e; }
    .g-nav .g-count { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0 10px 0 4px; white-space: nowrap; }
    .g-nav select {
      height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: transparent;
      color: #e8e8e8; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; padding: 0 8px;
    }
    .g-nav select:hover { background: #1d1d1d; }
    .g-nav select option { background: #101010; color: #f5f5f5; }

    .g-section-title {
      font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 20px 2px 12px; color: #d8d8d8;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    }
    .g-section-title .g-clear {
      font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--muted); background: none; border: none;
      cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .g-status { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 40px 0; text-align: center; }
    .g-status.error { color: #ff7d9c; }

    .g-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(148px, 1fr));
      gap: 18px 14px;
    }
    .g-card {
      position: relative; cursor: pointer; border: none; padding: 0;
      background: transparent; color: inherit; font-family: inherit; text-align: center;
      outline: none;
    }
    .g-card:focus-visible .g-cover { border-color: var(--ga); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); }
    .g-cover {
      display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden; background: #101010; border: 1px solid #1e1e1e;
      transition: transform 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease;
    }
    .g-cover img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
    .g-card:hover .g-cover {
      transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.02);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    }
    
    .g-name {
      position: relative; display: inline-block; max-width: 92%;
      margin-top: -12px; z-index: 2;
      background: var(--pill); border: 1px solid var(--pill-brd);
      border-radius: 10px; padding: 5px 10px;
      font-size: 0.72rem; color: #ddd;
      white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
      transition: border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
    }
    .g-card:hover .g-name { border-color: var(--ga); color: #fff; }
    .g-fav {
      position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; z-index: 3;
      width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
      display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1; padding: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.62); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
      color: #9a9a9a; backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
    }
    .g-fav:hover { transform: scale(1.15); color: #fff; }
    .g-fav.active { color: #ffd166; border-color: #ffd166; }
    .g-meta {
      position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 8px; z-index: 3; display: flex; gap: 5px;
    }
    .g-badge {
      font-size: 0.62rem; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px); color: #cfcfcf;
    }

    .g-pages {
      position: fixed; bottom: 14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 20; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.94);
      border: 1px solid var(--pill-brd); border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 5px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
      max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
    }
    .g-pages button {
      min-width: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px;
      border: none; background: transparent; color: #cfcfcf;
      font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.78rem; cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px;
      transition: background 0.14s ease, color 0.14s ease;
    }
    .g-pages button:hover { background: #1e1e1e; color: #fff; }
    .g-pages button.on { background: var(--ga); color: var(--ga-ink); font-weight: 700; }
    .g-pages .g-dots { color: #555; padding: 0 2px; font-size: 0.75rem; }
    .g-pages:empty { display: none; }

    #g-frame-wrap {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; background: #050505;
      display: none; flex-direction: column;
    }
    #g-frame-wrap.open { display: flex; }
    .g-frame-bar {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
      padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #232323; background: #0d0d0d;
    }
    .g-frame-bar strong { font-size: 0.95rem; flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .g-frame-bar button {
      padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent; color: #f5f5f5; border: 1px solid #232323;
      font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem;
      transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
    }
    .g-frame-bar button:hover { border-color: #fff; }
    #g-frame { flex: 1; width: 100%; border: 0; background: #050505; }

    @media (max-width: 560px) {
      .g-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(116px, 1fr)); gap: 14px 10px; }
      .g-nav input { width: 90px; }
      .g-nav .g-count { display: none; }
    }
</style>
  <script>
"use strict";
(function () {
    "use strict";
    var w = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : globalThis;
    function ls(key) {
        try {
            return localStorage.getItem(key) || "";
        }
        catch {
            return "";
        }
    }
    function apiBase() {
        return (w.__HAZE_API_BASE || ls("haze-api-base") || "").replace(/\/$/, "");
    }
    function api(path) {
        var base = apiBase();
        if (!path.startsWith("/"))
            path = "/" + path;
        return base + path;
    }
    function defaultWisp() {
        try {
            return ((location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss" : "ws") +
                "://" +
                location.host +
                "/wisp/");
        }
        catch {
            return "/wisp/";
        }
    }
    function wisp() {
        return w.__HAZE_WISP_URL || ls("haze-wisp-url") || defaultWisp();
    }
    w.__HAZE = w.__HAZE || {};
    w.__HAZE.apiBase = apiBase;
    w.HazeApi = api;
    w.HazeWisp = wisp;
})();
</script>

<nav class="g-nav">
    <button class="g-logo" id="g-home" type="button" title="All games">■  gnmath</button>
    <span class="g-div"></span>
    <button class="g-ico" id="g-random" type="button" title="Open a random game">🎲</button>
    <button class="g-ico on" id="g-favmode" type="button" title="Show favorites only">★</button>
    <button class="g-ico" id="g-reset" type="button" title="Forget play history and favorites">↻</button>
    <span class="g-div"></span>
    <label class="g-search">🔍
      <input id="g-search" type="text" placeholder="search…" autocomplete="off" />
    </label>
    <select id="g-sort" title="Sort games">
      <option value="default">A→Z</option>
      <option value="plays">most played</option>
      <option value="recent">recently played</option>
    </select>
    <span class="g-count" id="g-count"></span>
  </nav>

  <p class="g-status" id="g-status">Loading the library…</p>
  <div id="g-sections"></div>
  <div class="g-pages" id="g-pages"></div>

  <div id="g-frame-wrap">
    <div class="g-frame-bar">
      <strong id="g-frame-title"></strong>
      <button id="g-frame-full" type="button">⛶ Fullscreen</button>
      <button id="g-frame-close" type="button">✕ Close</button>
    </div>
    <iframe id="g-frame" title="game"></iframe>
  </div>

  <script>
"use strict";
(function () {
    "use strict";
    var COVERS = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freebuisness/covers@main";
    var RECENT_KEY = "haze-games-recent";
    var FAVS_KEY = "haze-games-favs";
    var PAGE_KEY = "haze-games-page";
    var PER_PAGE = 36;
    var games = [];
    var sections = document.getElementById("g-sections");
    var status = document.getElementById("g-status");
    var count = document.getElementById("g-count");
    var search = document.getElementById("g-search");
    var sortSel = document.getElementById("g-sort");
    var pagesEl = document.getElementById("g-pages");
    var favMode = false;
    var frameWrap = document.getElementById("g-frame-wrap");
    var frame = document.getElementById("g-frame");
    var frameTitle = document.getElementById("g-frame-title");
    var byId = {};
    function loadJson(key, fallback) {
        try {
            return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || fallback);
        }
        catch (e) {
            return JSON.parse(fallback);
        }
    }
    function recentMap() { return loadJson(RECENT_KEY, "{}"); }
    function favList() { return loadJson(FAVS_KEY, "[]"); }
    function esc(s) {
        return String(s || "").replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<");
    }
    function cardHtml(g, meta) {
        var badges = "";
        if (meta.plays > 0)
            badges += '<span class="g-badge">\u25b6 ' + meta.plays + "</span>";
        if (meta.last) {
            var mins = Math.floor((Date.now() - meta.last) / 60000);
            var when = mins < 1 ? "now" : mins < 60 ? mins + "m ago" : mins < 1440 ? Math.floor(mins / 60) + "h ago" : Math.floor(mins / 1440) + "d ago";
            badges += '<span class="g-badge">' + when + "</span>";
        }
        return ('<div class="g-card" data-id="' + g.id + '" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Play ' + esc(g.name) + '">' +
            '<span class="g-cover"><img loading="lazy" src="' + COVERS + "/" + g.id + '.png" alt="" onerror="this.style.display=\'none\'" />' +
            (badges ? '<span class="g-meta">' + badges + "</span>" : "") +
            "</span>" +
            '<button class="g-fav' + (meta.fav ? " active" : "") + '" data-fav="' + g.id + '" title="Favorite" type="button">\u2605</button>' +
            '<span class="g-name">' + esc(g.name) + "</span>" +
            "</div>");
    }
    function section(title, list, clearLabel) {
        var wrap = document.createElement("div");
        var h = document.createElement("div");
        h.className = "g-section-title";
        h.innerHTML = title + (clearLabel ? ' <button class="g-clear" type="button">' + clearLabel + "</button>" : "");
        wrap.appendChild(h);
        var grid = document.createElement("div");
        grid.className = "g-grid";
        var recents = recentMap();
        var favs = favList();
        grid.innerHTML = list
            .map(function (g) {
            var meta = recents[g.id] || {};
            meta.fav = favs.indexOf(String(g.id)) !== -1;
            return cardHtml(g, meta);
        })
            .join("");
        wrap.appendChild(grid);
        if (clearLabel) {
            h.querySelector(".g-clear").addEventListener("click", function () {
                localStorage.removeItem(RECENT_KEY);
                render();
            });
        }
        return wrap;
    }
    function pageNumbers(cur, total) {
        if (total <= 8) {
            var all = [];
            for (var i = 1; i <= total; i++)
                all.push(i);
            return all;
        }
        var set = [1, cur - 1, cur, cur + 1, total];
        if (cur <= 4)
            set = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, total];
        if (cur >= total - 3)
            set = [1, total - 4, total - 3, total - 2, total - 1, total];
        set = set.filter(function (p) { return p >= 1 && p <= total; });
        var uniq = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < set.length; j++)
            if (uniq.indexOf(set[j]) === -1)
                uniq.push(set[j]);
        uniq.sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
        return uniq;
    }
    function renderPages(cur, total) {
        pagesEl.innerHTML = "";
        if (total <= 1)
            return;
        var nums = pageNumbers(cur, total);
        var prev = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
            var p = nums[i];
            if (prev && p - prev > 1) {
                var dots = document.createElement("span");
                dots.className = "g-dots";
                dots.textContent = "\u2026";
                pagesEl.appendChild(dots);
            }
            var b = document.createElement("button");
            b.type = "button";
            b.textContent = String(p);
            if (p === cur)
                b.classList.add("on");
            b.addEventListener("click", function (page) {
                return function () {
                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem(PAGE_KEY, String(page));
                    }
                    catch (e) { }
                    render();
                    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
                };
            }(p));
            pagesEl.appendChild(b);
            prev = p;
        }
    }
    function render() {
        var q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        var recents = recentMap();
        var favs = favList();
        var list = games.slice();
        if (favMode) {
            list = list.filter(function (g) { return favs.indexOf(String(g.id)) !== -1; });
        }
        if (q) {
            list = list.filter(function (g) { return g.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; });
        }
        var sort = sortSel.value;
        if (sort === "plays") {
            list.sort(function (a, b) { return (recents[b.id] && recents[b.id].plays || 0) - (recents[a.id] && recents[a.id].plays || 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name); });
        }
        else if (sort === "recent") {
            list.sort(function (a, b) { return (recents[b.id] && recents[b.id].last || 0) - (recents[a.id] && recents[a.id].last || 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name); });
        }
        else {
            list.sort(function (a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name); });
        }
        count.textContent = list.length + (q ? " found" : " games");
        sections.innerHTML = "";
        renderPages(1, 1);
        if (!list.length) {
            status.textContent = favMode && !q ? "No favorites yet — tap \u2605 on any game." : q ? "No games match \"" + q + "\"." : "";
            status.hidden = !favMode && !q;
            status.className = "g-status";
            return;
        }
        status.hidden = true;
        if (!q && !favMode) {
            var recentGames = Object.keys(recents)
                .sort(function (a, b) { return (recents[b].last || 0) - (recents[a].last || 0); })
                .map(function (id) { return byId[id]; })
                .filter(Boolean)
                .slice(0, 12);
            if (recentGames.length) {
                sections.appendChild(section("\u23f1 Recently played", recentGames, "forget"));
            }
            var favGames = favs.map(function (id) { return byId[id]; }).filter(Boolean);
            if (favGames.length) {
                sections.appendChild(section("\u2605 Favorites", favGames));
            }
            var total = Math.ceil(list.length / PER_PAGE);
            var cur = Math.min(parseInt(localStorage.getItem(PAGE_KEY) || "1", 10) || 1, total);
            if (cur < 1)
                cur = 1;
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(PAGE_KEY, String(cur));
            }
            catch (e2) { }
            var pageList = list.slice((cur - 1) * PER_PAGE, cur * PER_PAGE);
            sections.appendChild(section("All games", pageList));
            renderPages(cur, total);
        }
        else {
            sections.appendChild(section(favMode ? "\u2605 Favorites" : "Results", list));
        }
    }
    function openGame(g) {
        frameTitle.textContent = g.name;
        var file = String(g.url).split("/").pop();
        frame.removeAttribute("srcdoc");
        frame.src = "about:blank";
        fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freebuisness/html@main/" + encodeURIComponent(file))
            .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok)
            throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.text(); })
            .then(function (html) { if (frameWrap.classList.contains("open"))
            frame.srcdoc = html; })
            .catch(function () { frame.srcdoc = '<body style="margin:0;height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#050505;color:#f5f5f5;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif">Couldn\u2019t load that game \u2014 try again.'; });
        frameWrap.classList.add("open");
        var recents = recentMap();
        var meta = recents[g.id] || { plays: 0, last: 0 };
        meta.plays = (meta.plays || 0) + 1;
        meta.last = Date.now();
        recents[g.id] = meta;
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(RECENT_KEY, JSON.stringify(recents));
        }
        catch (e) { }
    }
    function closeGame() {
        frameWrap.classList.remove("open");
        frame.removeAttribute("srcdoc");
        frame.src = "about:blank";
        render();
    }
    sections.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key !== "Enter" && e.key !== " ")
            return;
        var card = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".g-card") : null;
        if (!card || e.target !== card)
            return;
        e.preventDefault();
        var g = byId[card.dataset.id];
        if (g)
            openGame(g);
    });
    sections.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var favBtn = e.target.closest(".g-fav");
        if (favBtn) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            var id = favBtn.dataset.fav;
            var favs = favList();
            var idx = favs.indexOf(id);
            if (idx === -1)
                favs.push(id);
            else
                favs.splice(idx, 1);
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(FAVS_KEY, JSON.stringify(favs.slice(0, 30)));
            }
            catch (e2) { }
            render();
            return;
        }
        var card = e.target.closest(".g-card");
        if (!card)
            return;
        var g = byId[card.dataset.id];
        if (g)
            openGame(g);
    });
    document.getElementById("g-random").addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (!games.length)
            return;
        openGame(games[Math.floor(Math.random() * games.length)]);
    });
    document.getElementById("g-favmode").addEventListener("click", function () {
        favMode = !favMode;
        this.classList.toggle("on", favMode);
        render();
    });
    document.getElementById("g-reset").addEventListener("click", function () {
        localStorage.removeItem(RECENT_KEY);
        localStorage.removeItem(FAVS_KEY);
        render();
    });
    document.getElementById("g-home").addEventListener("click", function () {
        favMode = false;
        search.value = "";
        document.getElementById("g-favmode").classList.remove("on");
        try {
            localStorage.removeItem(PAGE_KEY);
        }
        catch (e) { }
        render();
    });
    sortSel.addEventListener("change", render);
    document.getElementById("g-frame-close").addEventListener("click", closeGame);
    document.getElementById("g-frame-full").addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (document.fullscreenElement)
            document.exitFullscreen().catch(function () { });
        else
            frameWrap.requestFullscreen().catch(function () { });
    });
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Escape" && frameWrap.classList.contains("open"))
            closeGame();
    });
    var searchTimer = null;
    search.addEventListener("input", function () {
        clearTimeout(searchTimer);
        searchTimer = setTimeout(render, 120);
    });
    try {
        var accent = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("haze-settings") || "{}").accent;
        if (accent)
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--ga", accent);
    }
    catch (e) { }
    fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freebuisness/assets@main/zones.json")
        .then(function (r) {
        if (!r.ok)
            throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
        return r.json();
    })
        .then(function (zones) {
        games = zones.filter(function (g) {
            return g && g.url && g.url.indexOf("{HTML_URL}") !== -1 && g.name;
        });
        for (var i = 0; i < games.length; i++) {
            games[i].id = String(games[i].id);
            byId[games[i].id] = games[i];
        }
        render();
    })
        .catch(function () {
        status.textContent = "Couldn't load the game library — the catalog wasn't reachable. Reload to retry.";
        status.className = "g-status error";
    });
})();
</script>
</template>

<!-- PAGE: ai frame -->
<template id="page-ai">
<style>
:root {
      --bg: #050507; --bg-panel: #0b0b0f; --bg-elev: #111116;
      --border: rgba(255,255,255,.09); --muted: rgba(255,255,255,.5);
      --accent: #b79bff; --text: #f2f2f5;
      --user-bubble: #1b1b22; --ai-bubble: transparent;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; }
    body {
      margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);
      font: 14px/1.55 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
      display: flex; overflow: hidden;
    }

    .side { width: 250px; flex: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-panel); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .side-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 16px 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .3px; }
    .side-brand .orb { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(from 180deg, #6ea8ff, #b79bff, #6ea8ff); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(183,155,255,.5); flex: none; }
    .side-brand small { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; margin-left: auto; }
    .side-actions { padding: 10px 12px; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
    .side-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; }
    .side-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .side-label { padding: 12px 18px 6px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; color: var(--muted); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    .side-search { margin: 6px 12px; }
    .side-search input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; outline: none; }
    .side-search input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .chat-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 4px 12px 12px; display: grid; gap: 4px; align-content: start; }
    .chat-item { text-align: left; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text); padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
    .chat-item:hover { background: var(--bg-elev); }
    .chat-item.active { background: var(--bg-elev); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border); }
    .chat-item .del { margin-left: auto; opacity: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; }
    .chat-item:hover .del { opacity: 1; }
    .side-foot { padding: 10px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

    .isu-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.74); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 70; }
    .isu-overlay.open { display: flex; }
    .isu { width: min(860px, 94vw); max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; background: #0d0d12; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; padding: 20px 22px; }
    .isu h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 19px; }
    .isu .sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .isu-prompt { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; font: inherit; outline: none; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .isu-prompt:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .isu-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .isu-row select, .isu-row input[type=number] { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; }
    .isu-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-left: auto; }
    .isu-go { border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: #14121c; border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 18px; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
    .isu-go:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); }
    .isu-go:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: wait; }
    .isu-close { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 14px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; }
    .isu-close:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .isu-out { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
    .isu-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-elev); position: relative; }
    .isu-card img { width: 100%; display: block; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; object-fit: cover; }
    .isu-card .dl { position: absolute; bottom: 8px; right: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: rgba(0,0,0,.65); color: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 9px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
    .isu-card .dl:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .isu-empty { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; padding: 20px 0; text-align: center; }

    .main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .top .title { font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13.5px; }
    .spacer { flex: 1; }
    .sel { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; max-width: 280px; cursor: pointer; outline: none; }
    .sel:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

    .mdu-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.72); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 60; }
    .mdu-overlay.open { display: flex; }
    .mdu { width: min(1040px, 94vw); height: min(660px, 88vh); background: #0d0d12; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.7); display: flex; overflow: hidden; }
    .mdu-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); flex: none; }
    .mdu-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; }
    .mdu-head small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; margin-left: 8px; }
    .mdu-x { margin-left: auto; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; font-size: 15px; }
    .mdu-x:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .mdu-rail { width: 92px; flex: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); overflow-y: auto; padding: 10px 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; scrollbar-width: none; }
    .mdu-rail::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .mdu-railbtn { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 4px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .mdu-railbtn .rail-ico { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; }
    .mdu-railbtn span.lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
    .mdu-railbtn:hover { background: var(--bg-elev); }
    .mdu-railbtn.active { background: var(--bg-elev); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border); }
    .mdu-railbtn.active .lbl { color: var(--text); }
    .mdu-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .mdu-searchrow { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 18px 10px; }
    .mdu-search { flex: 1; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 16px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; outline: none; }
    .mdu-search:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .mdu-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 4px 18px 18px; }
    .mdu-group { padding: 16px 2px 8px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .13em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
    .mdu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--text); font: inherit; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; }
    .mdu-item:hover { background: var(--bg-elev); }
    .mdu-item.selrow { background: var(--bg-elev); border-color: var(--border); }
    .mdu-item .mico { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 15px; }
    .mdu-item .mtxt { min-width: 0; }
    .mdu-item .mname { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; }
    .mdu-item .msub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 2px; }
    .mdu-item .mtag { margin-left: auto; flex: none; }
    .keychip, .nokeychip { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; }
    .keychip { color: #9ef2c6; background: rgba(78,222,155,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(78,222,155,.35); }
    .nokeychip { color: #ffca7a; background: rgba(255,202,122,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,202,122,.35); }
    .mdu-check { margin-left: 12px; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
    .keybtn { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
    .keybtn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }

    .msgs { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 24px 18px; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    .welcome { max-width: 720px; margin: 12vh auto 0; text-align: center; }
    .welcome h1 { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 26px; letter-spacing: -.5px; }
    .suggestions { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .sugg { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 16px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
    .sugg:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }

    .msg { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto 18px; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
    .msg .avatar { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .msg.user .avatar { background: #2a2a33; }
    .msg .bubble { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .msg .who { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: 600; }
    .msg .text { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
    .msg.ai .text { background: var(--bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 15px; }
    .msg .text code { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 5px; padding: 1px 5px; font-size: 12.5px; }
    .msg .text pre { background: #0a0a0e; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; overflow-x: auto; }
    .msg .text pre code { background: none; padding: 0; }
    .cursor { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 15px; background: var(--accent); vertical-align: text-bottom; animation: blink 1s steps(2) infinite; border-radius: 2px; }
    @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

    .composer-wrap { padding: 12px 18px 18px; }
    .composer { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-panel); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 14px; transition: border-color .15s; }
    .composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .composer textarea { width: 100%; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text); font: inherit; resize: none; outline: none; max-height: 180px; }
    .composer-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
    .send { margin-left: auto; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; font-size: 15px; }
    .send:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .send:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }
    .fineprint { max-width: 760px; margin: 8px auto 0; text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); }

    .empty-list { padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; }

    :root { --bg: #0b0b0d; --bg-panel: #101012; --bg-elev: #17171a; --border: rgba(255,255,255,.08); --muted: rgba(255,255,255,.55); }
    body { background: radial-gradient(1000px 480px at 50% -10%, rgba(255,255,255,.05), transparent 60%), var(--bg); }
    .side-newrow { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
    .side-btn.grow { flex: 1; }
    .side-btn.ico { flex: none; width: 42px; padding: 10px 0; justify-content: center; }
    .side-options { padding: 4px 16px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .ai-use { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
    .ai-usebar { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-elev); border: 1px solid var(--border); margin-top: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
    .ai-usebar div { height: 100%; width: 0; background: #f2f2f4; border-radius: 999px; transition: width .2s; }
    .side-local { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 8px; }
    body.ai-side-hide .side { display: none; }
    .top .title { font-weight: 600; }
    .welcome { margin-top: 9vh; }
    .welcome-eyebrow { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .18em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .welcome h1 { font-size: 40px; margin: 0 0 8px; }
    .welcome-sub { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 26px; font-size: 15px; }
    .composer.nx-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px; background: var(--bg-panel); }
    .composer.nx-pill .keybtn { flex: none; border-radius: 999px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .composer.nx-pill textarea { flex: 1; padding: 10px 6px; }

    .composer.nx-pill .send:hover { filter: brightness(.92); }
    @media (max-width: 760px) { .composer.nx-pill .keybtn b { display: none; } }
</style>
  <script>
"use strict";
(function () {
    "use strict";
    var w = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : globalThis;
    function ls(key) {
        try {
            return localStorage.getItem(key) || "";
        }
        catch {
            return "";
        }
    }
    function apiBase() {
        return (w.__HAZE_API_BASE || ls("haze-api-base") || "").replace(/\/$/, "");
    }
    function api(path) {
        var base = apiBase();
        if (!path.startsWith("/"))
            path = "/" + path;
        return base + path;
    }
    function defaultWisp() {
        try {
            return ((location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss" : "ws") +
                "://" +
                location.host +
                "/wisp/");
        }
        catch {
            return "/wisp/";
        }
    }
    function wisp() {
        return w.__HAZE_WISP_URL || ls("haze-wisp-url") || defaultWisp();
    }
    w.__HAZE = w.__HAZE || {};
    w.__HAZE.apiBase = apiBase;
    w.HazeApi = api;
    w.HazeWisp = wisp;
})();
</script>

<aside class="side">
    <div class="side-brand"><span class="orb"></span> haze AI <small id="model-count"></small></div>

  <div class="mdu-overlay" id="mdu-overlay">

<script>
"use strict";
(function () {
    "use strict";
    var PROVIDERS = {
        free: {
            label: "Free (no key)", endpoint: "/ai/relay",
            format: "openai", keyless: true, local: true,
            models: [
                { id: "openai-fast", name: "OpenAI GPT Fast (free)" },
                { id: "openai", name: "OpenAI GPT (free, may need seed tier)" },
                { id: "mistral", name: "Mistral (free, may need seed tier)" },
                { id: "qwen-coder", name: "Qwen Coder (free, may need seed tier)" },
                { id: "llama", name: "Llama (free, may need seed tier)" },
                { id: "deepseek", name: "DeepSeek (free, may need seed tier)" },
                { id: "gemini", name: "Gemini (free, may need seed tier)" }
            ]
        }
    };
    var PREF_KEY = "haze-ai-pref", HIST_KEY = "haze-ai-chats";
    var pref = loadPref(), chats = loadChats(), currentId = null, temporary = false;
    function jget(k, d) { try {
        return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)) ?? d;
    }
    catch {
        return d;
    } }
    function jset(k, v) { try {
        localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v));
    }
    catch { } }
    function loadPref() { return jget(PREF_KEY, { provider: "free", model: "openai-fast" }); }
    function loadChats() { return jget(HIST_KEY, []); }
    function saveChats() { if (!temporary)
        jset(HIST_KEY, chats.slice(0, 50)); }
    function updateUsage() {
        try {
            $("ai-use-tx").textContent = chats.length + " / 50";
            $("ai-use-fill").style.width = Math.min(100, (chats.length / 50) * 100) + "%";
        }
        catch { }
    }
    function uid() { return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7); }
    function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
    var msgsEl = $("msgs"), inputEl = $("input"), sendBtn = $("send");
    var convTitle = $("conv-title"), chatListEl = $("chat-list"), searchEl = $("chat-search");
    var PROVIDER_ICONS = {
        free: { glyph: "🐝", bg: "radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #ffe9a8, #e8b93c)" },
        openrouter: { glyph: "⌘", bg: "#1f1f28" },
        openai: { glyph: "◍", bg: "#101014" },
        anthropic: { glyph: "✳", bg: "#c96442" },
        google: { glyph: "✦", bg: "radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #7aa7ff, #3f6fe0)" },
        groq: { glyph: "⚡", bg: "#f55036" },
        deepseek: { glyph: "🐋", bg: "#4d6bfe" },
        mistral: { glyph: "◥", bg: "#ffd800", fg: "#111" },
        xai: { glyph: "𝕏", bg: "#101014" },
        together: { glyph: "⋈", bg: "#0f6fff" },
        cohere: { glyph: "◔", bg: "#39594d" }
    };
    function currentPid() { return pref.provider || "free"; }
    function currentModelId() {
        var pid = currentPid();
        var saved = pref[pid];
        var p = PROVIDERS[pid];
        return (saved && p.models.some(function (m) { return m.id === saved; })) ? saved : p.models[0].id;
    }
    function currentModelLabel() {
        var pid = currentPid(), p = PROVIDERS[pid], mid = currentModelId();
        var m = p.models.find(function (x) { return x.id === mid; });
        return m ? m.name : mid;
    }
    function updateModelBar() {
        $("cur-model-label").textContent = currentModelLabel();
        $("model-count").textContent = PROVIDERS[currentPid()].models.length + " models";
        var p = PROVIDERS[currentPid()];
        var needs = !p.keyless;
        $("fineprint").textContent = needs
            ? "Free models only — 'may need seed tier' ones auto-fallback to GPT Fast."
            : "haze AI can make mistakes. Text chats are saved on this device (up to 50 recent). Temporary chats keep nothing.";
    }
    function railIcon(pid) {
        var ico = PROVIDER_ICONS[pid] || { glyph: "◆", bg: "#1f1f28" };
        var d = document.createElement("div");
        d.className = "rail-ico";
        d.style.background = ico.bg;
        d.textContent = ico.glyph;
        if (ico.fg)
            d.style.color = ico.fg;
        return d;
    }
    function renderRail(filterText) {
        var rail = $("mdu-rail");
        rail.innerHTML = "";
        var q = (filterText || "").toLowerCase();
        Object.keys(PROVIDERS).forEach(function (pid) {
            var p = PROVIDERS[pid];
            if (q && !p.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !p.models.some(function (m) { return (m.name + " " + m.id).toLowerCase().includes(q); }))
                return;
            var b = document.createElement("button");
            b.type = "button";
            b.className = "mdu-railbtn" + (pid === currentPid() && !q ? " active" : "");
            b.appendChild(railIcon(pid));
            var l = document.createElement("span");
            l.className = "lbl";
            l.textContent = p.label.replace(" (no key)", "").split(" ")[0];
            b.appendChild(l);
            b.addEventListener("click", function () { $("mdu-search").value = ""; renderRail(""); renderModelList(""); });
            rail.appendChild(b);
        });
    }
    function renderModelList(filterText) {
        var list = $("mdu-list");
        list.innerHTML = "";
        var q = (filterText || "").toLowerCase();
        var total = 0;
        Object.keys(PROVIDERS).forEach(function (pid) {
            var p = PROVIDERS[pid];
            var matches = p.models.filter(function (m) {
                return !q || (m.name + " " + p.label + " " + m.id).toLowerCase().includes(q);
            });
            if (!matches.length)
                return;
            var tag = p.keyless ? "FREE" : "PAID";
            var g = document.createElement("div");
            g.className = "mdu-group";
            g.textContent = "· FREE MODELS ·";
            list.appendChild(g);
            matches.forEach(function (m) {
                total++;
                var b = document.createElement("button");
                b.type = "button";
                var selected = pid === currentPid() && m.id === currentModelId();
                b.className = "mdu-item" + (selected ? " selrow" : "");
                var ico = PROVIDER_ICONS[pid] || { glyph: "◆", bg: "#1f1f28" };
                var ic = document.createElement("div");
                ic.className = "mico";
                ic.style.background = ico.bg;
                ic.textContent = ico.glyph;
                if (ico.fg)
                    ic.style.color = ic.fg;
                var tx = document.createElement("div");
                tx.className = "mtxt";
                var nm = document.createElement("div");
                nm.className = "mname";
                nm.textContent = m.name;
                var sub = document.createElement("div");
                sub.className = "msub";
                sub.textContent = p.label.replace(" (no key)", "") + " · Text; Reasoning";
                tx.appendChild(nm);
                tx.appendChild(sub);
                var tagEl = document.createElement("span");
                tagEl.className = "mtag";
                if (!p.keyless) {
                    var chip = document.createElement("span");
                    chip.className = "nokeychip";
                    chip.textContent = "NO KEY";
                    tagEl.appendChild(chip);
                }
                b.appendChild(ic);
                b.appendChild(tx);
                b.appendChild(tagEl);
                if (selected) {
                    var c = document.createElement("span");
                    c.className = "mdu-check";
                    c.textContent = "✓";
                    b.appendChild(c);
                }
                b.addEventListener("click", function () {
                    pref.provider = pid;
                    pref[pid] = m.id;
                    jset(PREF_KEY, pref);
                    updateModelBar();
                    renderRail("");
                    renderModelList($("mdu-search").value);
                    closeModels();
                });
                list.appendChild(b);
            });
        });
        $("mdu-count").textContent = total + " available";
        if (!total) {
            var d = document.createElement("div");
            d.className = "empty-list";
            d.textContent = "No models match.";
            list.appendChild(d);
        }
    }
    function openModels() { $("mdu-overlay").classList.add("open"); $("mdu-search").value = ""; renderRail(""); renderModelList(""); $("mdu-search").focus(); }
    function closeModels() { $("mdu-overlay").classList.remove("open"); }
    $("btn-models").addEventListener("click", openModels);
    $("mdu-close").addEventListener("click", closeModels);
    $("mdu-overlay").addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === $("mdu-overlay"))
        closeModels(); });
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape")
        closeModels(); });
    $("mdu-search").addEventListener("input", function () { renderRail(this.value); renderModelList(this.value); });
    updateModelBar();
    function chatById(id) { return chats.find(function (c) { return c.id === id; }); }
    function activeChat() { return currentId ? chatById(currentId) : null; }
    function renderChatList() {
        chatListEl.innerHTML = "";
        var q = (searchEl.value || "").toLowerCase();
        var shown = chats.filter(function (c) {
            var t = (c.title || "") + " " + c.messages.map(function (m) { return m.content; }).join(" ");
            return !q || t.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        });
        if (!shown.length) {
            var d = document.createElement("div");
            d.className = "empty-list";
            d.textContent = "No chats yet.";
            chatListEl.appendChild(d);
            return;
        }
        shown.forEach(function (c) {
            var b = document.createElement("button");
            b.type = "button";
            b.className = "chat-item" + (c.id === currentId ? " active" : "");
            b.textContent = c.title || "New chat";
            b.addEventListener("click", function () { openChat(c.id); });
            var x = document.createElement("button");
            x.type = "button";
            x.className = "del";
            x.textContent = "✕";
            x.title = "Delete chat";
            x.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                chats = chats.filter(function (z) { return z.id !== c.id; });
                if (currentId === c.id) {
                    currentId = null;
                    showWelcome();
                }
                saveChats();
                renderChatList();
            });
            b.appendChild(x);
            chatListEl.appendChild(b);
        });
        updateUsage();
    }
    searchEl.addEventListener("input", renderChatList);
    $("btn-side").addEventListener("click", function () { document.body.classList.toggle("ai-side-hide"); });
    $("btn-history").addEventListener("click", function () { searchEl.focus(); });
    $("btn-trash").addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (!currentId)
            return;
        chats = chats.filter(function (z) { return z.id !== currentId; });
        currentId = null;
        saveChats();
        renderChatList();
        showWelcome();
    });
    function openChat(id) {
        currentId = id;
        temporary = false;
        var c = chatById(id);
        convTitle.textContent = c.title || "Conversation";
        renderMessages();
        renderChatList();
    }
    function showWelcome() {
        convTitle.textContent = "New conversation";
        msgsEl.innerHTML =
            '<div class="welcome"><div class="welcome-eyebrow">haze AI</div><h1>Welcome back</h1><p class="welcome-sub">What would you like to explore today?</p><div class="suggestions">' +
                '<button class="sugg" data-p="Help me plan a project step by step">▦ Plan a project</button>' +
                '<button class="sugg" data-p="Explain how black holes work in simple terms">◔ Explain something</button>' +
                '<button class="sugg" data-p="Review this code idea: a cache that never invalidates. What breaks?">◇ Review my code</button>' +
                '<button class="sugg" data-p="Brainstorm 10 names for a lo-fi study app">✦ Brainstorm ideas</button>' +
                "</div></div>";
    }
    msgsEl.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var s = e.target.closest(".sugg");
        if (s) {
            inputEl.value = s.dataset.p;
            inputEl.focus();
            autoGrow();
            submit();
        }
    });
    $("btn-new").addEventListener("click", function () { currentId = null; temporary = false; showWelcome(); renderChatList(); inputEl.focus(); });
    $("btn-temp").addEventListener("click", function () {
        currentId = null;
        temporary = true;
        showWelcome();
        renderChatList();
        inputEl.focus();
        convTitle.textContent = "Temporary chat";
    });
    var WELCOME_STRIP = null;
    function renderMessages() {
        var c = activeChat();
        if (!c)
            return;
        msgsEl.innerHTML = "";
        c.messages.forEach(function (m) { appendMsg(m.role, m.content); });
        msgsEl.scrollTop = msgsEl.scrollHeight;
    }
    function appendMsg(role, text, streaming) {
        var w = msgsEl.querySelector(".welcome");
        if (w)
            w.remove();
        var div = document.createElement("div");
        div.className = "msg " + role;
        div.innerHTML = '<div class="avatar">' + (role === "user" ? "You"[0] : "AI") + "</div>" +
            '<div class="bubble"><div class="who">' + (role === "user" ? "You" : currentModelName()) + '</div><div class="text"></div></div>';
        setBubbleText(div.querySelector(".text"), text);
        if (streaming)
            div.querySelector(".text").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", '<span class="cursor"></span>');
        msgsEl.appendChild(div);
        msgsEl.scrollTop = msgsEl.scrollHeight;
        return div;
    }
    function setBubbleText(el, text) {
        el.innerHTML = formatMd(String(text));
    }
    function formatMd(t) {
        var esc = t.replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<").replace(/>/g, ">");
        esc = esc.replace(/```(\w*)\n?([\s\S]*?)```/g, function (_, l, c) {
            return "<pre><code>" + c.replace(/\n$/, "") + "</code></pre>";
        });
        esc = esc.replace(/`([^`\n]+)`/g, "<code>$1</code>");
        esc = esc.replace(/\*\*([^*\n]+)\*\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>");
        return esc;
    }
    function currentModelName() {
        return currentModelLabel();
    }
    function autoGrow() { inputEl.style.height = "auto"; inputEl.style.height = Math.min(180, inputEl.scrollHeight) + "px"; }
    inputEl.addEventListener("input", autoGrow);
    inputEl.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            submit();
        }
    });
    $("composer").addEventListener("submit", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); submit(); });
    var busy = false;
    function submit() {
        if (busy)
            return;
        var text = inputEl.value.trim();
        if (!text)
            return;
        var pid = currentPid(), p = PROVIDERS[pid];
        var c = activeChat();
        if (!c) {
            c = { id: uid(), title: text.slice(0, 60), messages: [] };
            chats.unshift(c);
            currentId = c.id;
            convTitle.textContent = c.title;
            renderChatList();
        }
        c.messages.push({ role: "user", content: text });
        if (!temporary)
            saveChats();
        appendMsg("user", text);
        inputEl.value = "";
        autoGrow();
        var aiDiv = appendMsg("assistant", "", true);
        var aiTextEl = aiDiv.querySelector(".text");
        var acc = "";
        busy = true;
        sendBtn.disabled = true;
        callModel(pid, c.messages, {
            onDelta: function (d) {
                acc += d;
                aiTextEl.innerHTML = formatMd(acc) + '<span class="cursor"></span>';
                msgsEl.scrollTop = msgsEl.scrollHeight;
            },
            onDone: function () {
                aiTextEl.innerHTML = formatMd(acc);
                busy = false;
                sendBtn.disabled = false;
                if (!acc.trim())
                    acc = "(empty response)";
                c.messages.push({ role: "assistant", content: acc });
                if (!temporary)
                    saveChats();
            },
            onError: function (msg) {
                aiTextEl.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#ff8484">⚠ ' + escHtml(msg) + "</span>";
                busy = false;
                sendBtn.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }
    function escHtml(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<").replace(/>/g, ">"); }
    function callModel(pid, messages, cb) {
        var p = PROVIDERS[pid];
        var modelId = currentModelId();
        var headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
        var body;
        if (p.format === "anthropic") {
            var sys = "";
            var msgs = messages.filter(function (m) { return m.role !== "system"; }).map(function (m) { return { role: m.role, content: m.content }; });
            body = JSON.stringify({ model: modelId, max_tokens: 2048, messages: msgs, stream: true });
        }
        else {
            body = JSON.stringify({ model: modelId, messages: messages, stream: true, referrer: "haze", local: true });
        }
        fetch((typeof HazeApi === "function" ? HazeApi(p.endpoint) : p.endpoint), { method: "POST", headers: headers, body: body, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120000) })
            .then(function (res) {
            if (!res.ok) {
                return res.text().then(function (t) {
                    throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status + (t ? " — " + t.slice(0, 200) : ""));
                });
            }
            var reader = res.body.getReader();
            var dec = new TextDecoder();
            var buf = "";
            function pump() {
                return reader.read().then(function (r) {
                    if (r.done) {
                        cb.onDone();
                        return;
                    }
                    buf += dec.decode(r.value, { stream: true });
                    var lines = buf.split("\n");
                    buf = lines.pop();
                    lines.forEach(function (line) {
                        line = line.trim();
                        if (!line || !line.startsWith("data:"))
                            return;
                        var payload = line.slice(5).trim();
                        if (payload === "[DONE]") {
                            return;
                        }
                        try {
                            var j = JSON.parse(payload);
                            if (p.format === "anthropic") {
                                if (j.type === "content_block_delta" && j.delta && (j.delta.text || j.delta.thinking))
                                    cb.onDelta(j.delta.text || "");
                            }
                            else {
                                var d = j.choices && j.choices[0] && (j.choices[0].delta || j.choices[0].message);
                                if (d && d.content)
                                    cb.onDelta(d.content);
                            }
                        }
                        catch { }
                    });
                    return pump();
                });
            }
            return pump();
        })
            .catch(function (err) {
            cb.onError(err.name === "TimeoutError" ? "Request timed out." : (err.message || "Request failed."));
        });
    }
    var ISU_KEY = "haze-ai-images";
    var isuOverlay = $("isu-overlay"), isuPrompt = $("isu-prompt"), isuStyle = $("isu-style"), isuSize = $("isu-size"), isuGo = $("isu-go"), isuOut = $("isu-out");
    var isuImages = jget(ISU_KEY, []);
    function escHtml2(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<").replace(/>/g, ">"); }
    function renderIsuOut() {
        if (!isuImages.length) {
            isuOut.innerHTML = '<div class="isu-empty">Your generated images will appear here. They stay on your device.</div>';
            return;
        }
        isuOut.innerHTML = "";
        isuImages.forEach(function (item, i) {
            var card = document.createElement("div");
            card.className = "isu-card";
            var img = document.createElement("img");
            img.src = item.url;
            img.alt = item.prompt;
            img.title = item.prompt;
            img.style.aspectRatio = "auto";
            img.style.transition = "opacity .4s";
            img.style.opacity = "0";
            img.onload = function () { img.style.opacity = "1"; };
            img.onerror = function () { card.style.opacity = ".4"; card.title = "Failed to load"; };
            var dl = document.createElement("button");
            dl.className = "dl";
            dl.textContent = "⬇ Save";
            dl.type = "button";
            dl.addEventListener("click", function () {
                var a = document.createElement("a");
                a.href = item.url;
                a.download = "haze-image-" + (item.seed || i) + ".jpg";
                a.target = "_blank";
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                a.remove();
            });
            var del = document.createElement("button");
            del.className = "dl";
            del.textContent = "✕";
            del.type = "button";
            del.style.right = "84px";
            del.addEventListener("click", function () {
                isuImages.splice(i, 1);
                jset(ISU_KEY, isuImages);
                renderIsuOut();
            });
            card.appendChild(img);
            card.appendChild(dl);
            card.appendChild(del);
            isuOut.appendChild(card);
        });
    }
    function openIsu() { isuOverlay.classList.add("open"); renderIsuOut(); isuPrompt.focus(); }
    function closeIsu() { isuOverlay.classList.remove("open"); }
    $("btn-images").addEventListener("click", openIsu);
    $("isu-close").addEventListener("click", closeIsu);
    isuOverlay.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === isuOverlay)
        closeIsu(); });
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape")
        closeIsu(); });
    isuGo.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var raw = isuPrompt.value.trim();
        if (!raw) {
            isuPrompt.focus();
            return;
        }
        var style = isuStyle.value;
        var fullPrompt = style ? (raw + " — " + style) : raw;
        var size = isuSize.value;
        var seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000);
        var url = "https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/" + encodeURIComponent(fullPrompt) +
            "?width=" + size.split("x")[0] + "&height=" + size.split("x")[1] +
            "&seed=" + seed + "&nologo=true&referrer=haze";
        isuImages.unshift({ prompt: raw, url: url, seed: seed, at: Date.now(), size: size });
        if (isuImages.length > 12)
            isuImages.length = 12;
        jset(ISU_KEY, isuImages);
        isuGo.disabled = true;
        isuGo.textContent = "Generating…";
        renderIsuOut();
        setTimeout(function () { isuGo.disabled = false; isuGo.textContent = "Generate"; }, 3500);
    });
    renderChatList();
    showWelcome();
    inputEl.focus();
})();
</script>
</template>

  <div id="a-sections"></div>

  <script>
"use strict";
(function () {
    "use strict";
    var HUB = [
        { id: "chat", name: "haze chat", icon: "\uD83D\uDCAC", kind: "go", view: "chat", desc: "On-device chat rooms with guest login." },
        { id: "music", name: "hazefy", icon: "\uD83C\uDFB5", kind: "go", view: "music", desc: "Search songs and play previews with built-in music." },
        { id: "ai", name: "haze ai", icon: "\uD83E\uDD16", kind: "go", view: "ai", desc: "Ask the built-in AI assistant." },
        { id: "games", name: "haze games", icon: "\uD83C\uDFAE", kind: "go", view: "games", desc: "Game zones ready to play." },
        { id: "code", name: "hazecode", icon: "\uD83E\uDDF0", kind: "go", view: "studio", sub: "code", desc: "HTML+CSS+JS sandbox with sealed preview." },
        { id: "links", name: "hazelinks", icon: "\uD83D\uDD17", kind: "go", view: "studio", sub: "links", desc: "Paste URLs, get honest OK / HTTP / timeout status." },
        { id: "cloak", name: "hazecloak", icon: "\uD83D\uDD75\uFE0F", kind: "go", view: "studio", sub: "maker", desc: "Build cloaked about:blank launcher snippets." },
        { id: "text", name: "hazetext", icon: "\uD83D\uDCDD", kind: "go", view: "studio", sub: "text", desc: "Word count, case tools and base64 (Text Lab)." },
        { id: "keys", name: "hazekeys", icon: "\uD83D\uDD11", kind: "go", view: "settings", desc: "Proxy engine, keys and haze preferences." },
        { id: "tube", name: "hazetube", icon: "\u25B6\uFE0F", kind: "url", url: "https://www.youtube.com/", desc: "YouTube through the haze proxy." },
        { id: "flix", name: "hazeflix", icon: "\uD83C\uDF7F", kind: "url", url: "https://www.themoviedb.org/", desc: "Browse movies and shows, trailers included." },
        { id: "watch", name: "hazewatch", icon: "\uD83D\uDCFA", kind: "url", url: "https://www.justwatch.com/", desc: "Where any show is streaming legally." },
        { id: "cloud", name: "hazecloud", icon: "\u2601\uFE0F", kind: "url", url: "https://play.geforcenow.com/", desc: "Cloud gaming in the browser." },
        { id: "tok", name: "hazetok", icon: "\uD83D\uDCF1", kind: "url", url: "https://www.tiktok.com/", desc: "Short-form video through the haze proxy." },
        { id: "anime", name: "hazeanime", icon: "\u26E9\uFE0F", kind: "url", url: "https://animex.one/", desc: "Anime streaming and tracking." },
        { id: "duck", name: "hazeduck", icon: "\uD83E\uDD86", kind: "url", url: "https://duck.ai/", desc: "Private AI chat through the haze proxy." },
        { id: "deliver", name: "hazedeliver", icon: "\uD83D\uDCE6", kind: "url", url: "https://www.jsdelivr.com/", desc: "Free CDN for open-source packages." }
    ];
    var FAVS_KEY = "haze-hub-favs";
    var RECENT_KEY = "haze-hub-recent";
    var sections = document.getElementById("a-sections");
    var status = document.getElementById("a-status");
    var count = document.getElementById("a-count");
    var search = document.getElementById("a-search");
    var favMode = false;
    function loadJson(key, fallback) {
        try {
            return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || fallback);
        }
        catch (e) {
            return JSON.parse(fallback);
        }
    }
    function esc(s) {
        return String(s || "").replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<");
    }
    function byId(id) {
        for (var i = 0; i < HUB.length; i++)
            if (HUB[i].id === id)
                return HUB[i];
        return null;
    }
    function openTile(tile) {
        var recents = loadJson(RECENT_KEY, "[]").filter(function (r) { return r !== tile.id; });
        recents.unshift(tile.id);
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(RECENT_KEY, JSON.stringify(recents.slice(0, 10)));
        }
        catch (e) { }
        try {
            if (tile.kind === "go" && window.parent && window.parent.hazeGo) {
                window.parent.hazeGo(tile.view, tile.sub);
                return;
            }
            if (tile.kind === "url" && window.parent && window.parent.hazeLaunch) {
                window.parent.hazeLaunch(tile.url);
                return;
            }
        }
        catch (e) { }
        if (tile.url)
            window.open(tile.url, "_blank", "noopener");
    }
    function tileHtml(tile) {
        var favs = loadJson(FAVS_KEY, "[]");
        var isFav = favs.indexOf(tile.id) !== -1;
        return ('<button class="a-tile" data-id="' + esc(tile.id) + '" type="button" aria-label="Open ' + esc(tile.name) + '">' +
            '<span class="a-icon">' + esc(tile.icon) + "</span>" +
            '<span class="a-meta"><span class="a-name">' + esc(tile.name) + "</span>" +
            '<span class="a-desc" style="display:block">' + esc(tile.desc) + "</span>" +
            '<span class="a-kind' + (tile.kind === "go" ? " builtin" : "") + '">' +
            (tile.kind === "go" ? "built-in" : "proxy") + "</span></span>" +
            '<span class="a-fav' + (isFav ? " active" : "") + '" data-fav="' + esc(tile.id) + '" title="Favorite" role="button" tabindex="0">\u2605</span>' +
            "</button>");
    }
    function section(title, list, clearLabel) {
        var wrap = document.createElement("div");
        var h = document.createElement("div");
        h.className = "a-section-title";
        h.innerHTML = esc(title) + (clearLabel ? ' <button class="a-clear" type="button">' + esc(clearLabel) + "</button>" : "");
        wrap.appendChild(h);
        var grid = document.createElement("div");
        grid.className = "a-grid";
        grid.innerHTML = list.map(tileHtml).join("");
        wrap.appendChild(grid);
        if (clearLabel) {
            h.querySelector(".a-clear").addEventListener("click", function () {
                localStorage.removeItem(clearLabel === "forget" ? RECENT_KEY : FAVS_KEY);
                render();
            });
        }
        return wrap;
    }
    function render() {
        var q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        var favs = loadJson(FAVS_KEY, "[]");
        var list = HUB.slice();
        if (favMode)
            list = list.filter(function (t) { return favs.indexOf(t.id) !== -1; });
        if (q) {
            list = list.filter(function (t) {
                return (t.name + " " + t.desc).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
            });
        }
        count.textContent = list.length + (list.length === 1 ? " app" : " apps");
        sections.innerHTML = "";
        if (!list.length) {
            status.hidden = false;
            status.textContent = favMode && !q
                ? "No favorites yet \u2014 hover an app and tap \u2605."
                : q ? 'No apps match "' + q + '".' : "";
            return;
        }
        status.hidden = true;
        if (!q && !favMode) {
            var recents = loadJson(RECENT_KEY, "[]").map(byId).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6);
            if (recents.length)
                sections.appendChild(section("\u23F1 Recently opened", recents, "forget"));
            var favTiles = HUB.filter(function (t) { return favs.indexOf(t.id) !== -1; });
            if (favTiles.length)
                sections.appendChild(section("\u2605 Favorites", favTiles));
            sections.appendChild(section("Built into haze", HUB.filter(function (t) { return t.kind === "go"; })));
            sections.appendChild(section("Through the proxy", HUB.filter(function (t) { return t.kind === "url"; })));
        }
        else {
            sections.appendChild(section(favMode ? "\u2605 Favorites" : "Results", list));
        }
    }
    sections.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var favBtn = e.target.closest(".a-fav");
        if (favBtn) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            var id = favBtn.getAttribute("data-fav");
            var favs = loadJson(FAVS_KEY, "[]");
            var idx = favs.indexOf(id);
            if (idx === -1)
                favs.push(id);
            else
                favs.splice(idx, 1);
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(FAVS_KEY, JSON.stringify(favs.slice(0, 60)));
            }
            catch (e2) { }
            render();
            return;
        }
        var tile = e.target.closest(".a-tile");
        if (!tile)
            return;
        var picked = byId(tile.getAttribute("data-id"));
        if (picked)
            openTile(picked);
    });
    document.getElementById("a-favmode").addEventListener("click", function () {
        favMode = !favMode;
        this.classList.toggle("on", favMode);
        render();
    });
    document.getElementById("a-reset").addEventListener("click", function () {
        localStorage.removeItem(FAVS_KEY);
        localStorage.removeItem(RECENT_KEY);
        render();
    });
    document.getElementById("a-home").addEventListener("click", function () {
        favMode = false;
        search.value = "";
        document.getElementById("a-favmode").classList.remove("on");
        render();
    });
    var searchTimer = null;
    search.addEventListener("input", function () {
        clearTimeout(searchTimer);
        searchTimer = setTimeout(render, 150);
    });
    try {
        var accent = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("haze-settings") || "{}").accent;
        if (accent)
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--aa", accent);
    }
    catch (e) { }
    window.hazeRandomApp = function () {
        openTile(HUB[Math.floor(Math.random() * HUB.length)]);
    };
    render();
})();
</script>
</template>

<!-- SCRIPT: config -->
<script>
"use strict";
(function () {
    "use strict";
    var w = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : globalThis;
    function ls(key) {
        try {
            return localStorage.getItem(key) || "";
        }
        catch {
            return "";
        }
    }
    function apiBase() {
        return (w.__HAZE_API_BASE || ls("haze-api-base") || "").replace(/\/$/, "");
    }
    function api(path) {
        var base = apiBase();
        if (!path.startsWith("/"))
            path = "/" + path;
        return base + path;
    }
    function defaultWisp() {
        try {
            return ((location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss" : "ws") +
                "://" +
                location.host +
                "/wisp/");
        }
        catch {
            return "/wisp/";
        }
    }
    function wisp() {
        return w.__HAZE_WISP_URL || ls("haze-wisp-url") || defaultWisp();
    }
    w.__HAZE = w.__HAZE || {};
    w.__HAZE.apiBase = apiBase;
    w.HazeApi = api;
    w.HazeWisp = wisp;
})();
</script>

<!-- SCRIPT: search -->
<script>
"use strict";
function search(input, template) {
    try {
        return new URL(input).toString();
    }
    catch (err) {
    }
    try {
        const url = new URL(`http://${input}`);
        if (url.hostname.includes("."))
            return url.toString();
    }
    catch (err) {
    }
    return template.replace("%s", encodeURIComponent(input));
}
window.search = search;
</script>

<script>
const buildDoc = (id) =>
  "<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0\"></head><body>" +
  document.getElementById(id).innerHTML +
  "</body></html>";
[["games-frame", "page-games"], ["ai-frame", "page-ai"], ["apps-frame", "page-apps"]].forEach(([frame, id]) => {
  document.getElementById(frame).srcdoc = buildDoc(id);
});
</script>

<!-- SCRIPT: main -->
<script type="module">
"use strict";
const form = document.getElementById("sj-form");
const address = document.getElementById("sj-address");
const searchEngine = document.getElementById("sj-search-engine");
const error = document.getElementById("sj-error");
const errorCode = document.getElementById("sj-error-code");
const frameExit = document.getElementById("frame-exit");
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
let controller = null;
let activeFrame = null;
const navItems = document.querySelectorAll(".nav-item");
const views = document.querySelectorAll(".view");
function toggleView(view) {
    navItems.forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.view === view));
    views.forEach((v) => v.classList.toggle("active", v.dataset.viewSection === view));
    document.body.classList.toggle("fullbleed", view !== "ai");
    document.body.classList.toggle("ai-immerse", view === "ai");
}
navItems.forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        toggleView(btn.dataset.view);
    });
});
const gamesWrap = document.querySelector(".games-wrap");
const appsWrap = document.querySelector(".apps-wrap");
const STORE_KEY = "haze-settings";
function loadSettings() {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY) || "{}");
    }
    catch {
        return {};
    }
}

function applyWallpaper(dataUrl) {
    if (dataUrl) {
        wallpaperLayer.style.backgroundImage = `url(${dataUrl})`;
        wallpaperLayer.classList.add("visible");
        wallpaperPreview.style.backgroundImage = `url(${dataUrl})`;
        wallpaperPreview.hidden = false;
        wallpaperClear.hidden = false;
    }
    else {

        wallpaperLayer.classList.remove("visible");
        wallpaperPreview.hidden = true;

        return;

        try {
            localStorage.setItem("haze-wallpaper", String(reader.result));
            applyWallpaper(String(reader.result));
        }
        catch {
            applyWallpaper(String(reader.result));
            wallpaperClear.hidden = false;
            error.textContent = "Image too large to save permanently — applied for this session.";
            setTimeout(() => (error.textContent = ""), 4000);
        }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
});

    55: ["🌦️", "Drizzle"], 61: ["🌧️", "Light rain"], 63: ["🌧️", "Rain"], 65: ["🌧️", "Heavy rain"],
